name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additiveKernel_eq_sum_exp
statement:
theorem additiveKernel_eq_sum_exp (N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    additiveKernel N θ =
      ∑ n ∈ range N, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((n : ℝ) * θ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additivePhase_eq_exp
statement:
theorem additivePhase_eq_exp (θ : ℝ) :
    additivePhase θ = Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * θ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additivePhase_pow
statement:
theorem additivePhase_pow (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    additivePhase θ ^ n = additivePhase (n * θ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additivePhase_sub
statement:
theorem additivePhase_sub (θ φ : ℝ) :
    additivePhase (θ - φ) = additivePhase θ * starRingEnd ℂ (additivePhase φ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additivePhase_sub_int
statement:
theorem additivePhase_sub_int (θ : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    additivePhase (θ - m) = additivePhase θ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.four_mul_norm_unitAddCircle_le_chord
statement:
theorem four_mul_norm_unitAddCircle_le_chord (θ : ℝ) :
    4 * ‖(θ : UnitAddCircle)‖ ≤ ‖1 - additivePhase θ‖

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_additiveKernel_le_length
statement:
theorem norm_additiveKernel_le_length (N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖additiveKernel N θ‖ ≤ N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_additiveKernel_le_min
statement:
theorem norm_additiveKernel_le_min (N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : (θ : UnitAddCircle) ≠ 0) :
    ‖additiveKernel N θ‖ ≤ min (N : ℝ) (1 / (2 * ‖(θ : UnitAddCircle)‖))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_additiveKernel_le_of_separated
statement:
theorem norm_additiveKernel_le_of_separated (N : ℕ) (θ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hθ : δ ≤ ‖(θ : UnitAddCircle)‖) :
    ‖additiveKernel N θ‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * δ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_additivePhase
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_additivePhase (θ : ℝ) : ‖additivePhase θ‖ = 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_geom_sum_Ico_le_length
statement:
theorem norm_geom_sum_Ico_le_length {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (M N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, z ^ n‖ ≤ (N - M : ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_geom_sum_Ico_le_min
statement:
theorem norm_geom_sum_Ico_le_min {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hz1 : z ≠ 1)
    (M N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, z ^ n‖ ≤ min ((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) (2 / ‖1 - z‖)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_geom_sum_le_length
statement:
theorem norm_geom_sum_le_length {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ range N, z ^ n‖ ≤ N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_geom_sum_le_min
statement:
theorem norm_geom_sum_le_min {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hz1 : z ≠ 1)
    (N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ range N, z ^ n‖ ≤ min (N : ℝ) (2 / ‖1 - z‖)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_geom_sum_le_two_div
statement:
theorem norm_geom_sum_le_two_div {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hz1 : z ≠ 1)
    (N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ range N, z ^ n‖ ≤ 2 / ‖1 - z‖

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_shifted_geom_sum_eq
statement:
theorem norm_shifted_geom_sum_eq {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (M N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ range N, z ^ (M + n)‖ = ‖∑ n ∈ range N, z ^ n‖

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_Ico_additivePhase_le_length
statement:
theorem norm_sum_Ico_additivePhase_le_length (M N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * θ)‖ ≤ (N - M : ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_Ico_additivePhase_le_min
statement:
theorem norm_sum_Ico_additivePhase_le_min (M N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : (θ : UnitAddCircle) ≠ 0) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * θ)‖ ≤
      min ((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) (1 / (2 * ‖(θ : UnitAddCircle)‖))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_Ico_phase_mul_conj_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_Ico_phase_mul_conj_le (M N : ℕ) (θ φ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : δ ≤ dist (θ : UnitAddCircle) (φ : UnitAddCircle)) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * θ) *
      starRingEnd ℂ (additivePhase (n * φ))‖ ≤
      min ((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) (1 / (2 * δ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ico_phase_mul_conj_eq
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_phase_mul_conj_eq (M N : ℕ) (θ φ : ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * θ) *
      starRingEnd ℂ (additivePhase (n * φ))) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * (θ - φ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.finite_additive_large_sieve_of_kernel_rows
statement:
theorem finite_additive_large_sieve_of_kernel_rows {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (θ : ι → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (M N : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
      ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * (θ i - θ j))‖ ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n * additivePhase (n * θ i)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B * ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.finite_large_sieve
statement:
theorem finite_large_sieve {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (s : Finset ι)
    (E : ι → κ → ℂ) (a : κ → ℂ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
      ‖∑ n : κ, E i n * starRingEnd ℂ (E j n)‖ ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n : κ, a n * E i n‖ ^ 2) ≤ B * ∑ n : κ, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.finite_large_sieve_finset
statement:
theorem finite_large_sieve_finset {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (E : ι → κ → ℂ) (a : κ → ℂ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
      ‖∑ n ∈ t, E i n * starRingEnd ℂ (E j n)‖ ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ t, a n * E i n‖ ^ 2) ≤ B * ∑ n ∈ t, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.finite_schur_bound
statement:
theorem finite_schur_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → ι → ℝ)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ K i j)
    (hsym : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, K i j = K j i)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, K i j ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, w i * w j * K i j) ≤ B * ∑ i ∈ s, (w i) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_smul_sq_le_gram_row
statement:
theorem norm_sum_smul_sq_le_gram_row (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → H)
    (b : ι → ℂ) (B : ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, ‖inner ℂ (v i) (v j)‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, b i • v i‖ ^ 2 ≤ B * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖b i‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_norm_inner_sq_le_gram_row
statement:
theorem sum_norm_inner_sq_le_gram_row (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → H)
    (x : H) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hrow : ∀ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, ‖inner ℂ (v i) (v j)‖ ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖inner ℂ (v i) x‖ ^ 2) ≤ B * ‖x‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticLogWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem arithmeticLogWeight_apply (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    arithmeticLogWeight f n = f n * Real.log n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticLogWeight_moebius
statement:
theorem arithmeticLogWeight_moebius :
    arithmeticLogWeight (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) =
      -((μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * vonMangoldt)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticLogWeight_mul
statement:
theorem arithmeticLogWeight_mul (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    arithmeticLogWeight (f * g) =
      arithmeticLogWeight f * g + f * arithmeticLogWeight g

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticLogWeight_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem arithmeticLogWeight_neg (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    arithmeticLogWeight (-f) = -arithmeticLogWeight f

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticLogWeight_twice_moebius
statement:
theorem arithmeticLogWeight_twice_moebius :
    arithmeticLogWeight (arithmeticLogWeight (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) =
      (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) *
        (vonMangoldt * vonMangoldt - arithmeticLogWeight vonMangoldt)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebius_mul_centeredSelbergCoefficient
statement:
theorem moebius_mul_centeredSelbergCoefficient (c : ℝ) :
    (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * centeredSelbergCoefficient c =
      arithmeticLogWeight (arithmeticLogWeight (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) -
        (2 * c) • (1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebius_mul_centeredSelbergCoefficient_apply
statement:
theorem moebius_mul_centeredSelbergCoefficient_apply (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      (μ d.1 : ℝ) * centeredSelbergCoefficient c d.2) =
      (μ n : ℝ) * (Real.log n) ^ 2 - if n = 1 then 2 * c else 0

statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffHigh_apply (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (U n : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.cutoffLow_add_cutoffHigh
statement:
theorem cutoffLow_add_cutoffHigh (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (U : ℕ) :
    cutoffLow f U + cutoffHigh f U = f

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.cutoffLow_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffLow_apply (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (U n : ℕ) :
    cutoffLow f U n = if n ≤ U then f n else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_apply
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_apply (V n : ℕ) :
    vaughanBeta V n = ∑ b ∈ n.divisors, if V < b then vonMangoldt b else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_eq_log_sub
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_eq_log_sub (V n : ℕ) :
    vaughanBeta V n = Real.log n -
      ∑ b ∈ n.divisors, if b ≤ V then vonMangoldt b else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_eq_zero_of_le (V n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ V) :
    vaughanBeta V n = 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_le_log
statement: theorem vaughanBeta_le_log (V n : ℕ) : vaughanBeta V n ≤ Real.log n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_nonneg
statement: theorem vaughanBeta_nonneg (V n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ vaughanBeta V n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBilinear_apply
statement:
theorem vaughanBilinear_apply (U V n : ℕ) :
    (moebiusHigh U * vaughanBeta V) n =
      ∑ dr ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        if U < dr.1 ∧ V < dr.2 then (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanCoefficient_apply
statement:
theorem vaughanCoefficient_apply (U V n : ℕ) :
    vaughanCoefficient U V n =
      ∑ db ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        if db.1 ≤ U ∧ db.2 ≤ V then (μ db.1 : ℝ) * vonMangoldt db.2 else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanCoefficient_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem vaughanCoefficient_eq_zero_of_lt (U V n : ℕ) (hn : U * V < n) :
    vaughanCoefficient U V n = 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanIdentity
statement:
theorem vaughanIdentity (U V : ℕ) :
    vonMangoldt =
      moebiusLow U * ArithmeticFunction.log -
      moebiusLow U * mangoldtLow V * ζ + mangoldtLow V +
      moebiusHigh U * mangoldtHigh V * ζ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanIdentity_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem vaughanIdentity_apply_of_lt (U V n : ℕ) (hn : V < n) :
    vonMangoldt n = (moebiusLow U * ArithmeticFunction.log) n -
      (vaughanCoefficient U V * ζ) n + (moebiusHigh U * vaughanBeta V) n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanIdentity_sum
statement:
theorem vaughanIdentity_sum (U V : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, V < n) :
    (∑ n ∈ s, vonMangoldt n * w n) =
      (∑ n ∈ s, (moebiusLow U * ArithmeticFunction.log) n * w n) -
      (∑ n ∈ s, (vaughanCoefficient U V * ζ) n * w n) +
      ∑ n ∈ s, (moebiusHigh U * vaughanBeta V) n * w n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebius_log_div_le
statement:
theorem abs_moebius_log_div_le (U d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ U) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusLow_mul_log_apply
statement:
theorem moebiusLow_mul_log_apply (U n : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.truncatedMangoldt_eq
statement:
theorem truncatedMangoldt_eq (U n : ℕ) (hU : 0 < U) :
    truncatedMangoldt U n = Real.log U * truncatedMoebiusSum U n -
      ∑ d ∈ n.divisors with d ≤ U, (μ d : ℝ) * Real.log d

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.truncatedMangoldt_eq_moduli
statement:
theorem truncatedMangoldt_eq_moduli (U n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    truncatedMangoldt U n = ∑ d ∈ range (U + 1) with d ∣ n,
      (μ d : ℝ) * Real.log ((U : ℝ) / d)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.truncatedMoebiusLog_eq
statement:
theorem truncatedMoebiusLog_eq (U n : ℕ) (hU : 0 < U) (hn : 0 < n) :
    truncatedMoebiusLog U n = truncatedMangoldt U n +
      Real.log ((n : ℝ) / U) * truncatedMoebiusSum U n

name: SelbergSieve.selbergWeights_diagonalisation

theorem selbergWeights_diagonalisation (l : ℕ) (hl : l ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes) :
    (∑ d ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes, if l ∣ d then s.nu d * s.selbergWeights d else 0) =
      if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.selbergTerms l * μ l * (s.selbergBoundingSum)⁻¹ else 0

name: SelbergSieve.selbergWeights_eq_dvds_sum

      (s.selbergBoundingSum)⁻¹ * μ d *
        ∑ l ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes,
          if d ∣ l ∧ (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.selbergTerms l else 0

name: SelbergSieve.selberg_bound_simple
statement:
theorem selberg_bound_simple :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusTotient_mul_prime
TwinPrime.Analytic.moebius_mangoldt_totient_mul
statement:
theorem moebius_mangoldt_totient_mul (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (μ d : ℝ) * vonMangoldt b / Nat.totient (d * b) =
      ((μ d : ℝ) / Nat.totient d) * (vonMangoldt b / Nat.totient b) -
      (if b.minFac ∣ d then (μ d : ℝ) / Nat.totient d else 0) *
        (vonMangoldt b / ((b.minFac : ℝ) * Nat.totient b))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddCutoff_filter_dvd_eq_image
statement:
theorem oddCutoff_filter_dvd_eq_image (U p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hpodd : Odd p) :
    (oddCutoff U).filter (p ∣ ·) =
      (oddCutoff (U / p)).image (fun d => p * d)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_eq_sum_mul
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_eq_sum_mul (U p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpodd : Odd p) :
    oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible U p =
      ∑ d ∈ oddCutoff (U / p), (μ (p * d) : ℝ) / Nat.totient (p * d)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_recurrence
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_recurrence (U p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpodd : Odd p) :
    oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible U p =
      -(oddMoebiusTotientSum (U / p) - oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible (U / p) p) /
        ((p : ℝ) - 1)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocal_totient_mul_prime_pow
statement:
theorem reciprocal_totient_mul_prime_pow (p d k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (1 : ℝ) / Nat.totient (d * p ^ (k + 1)) =
      1 / ((Nat.totient d : ℝ) * Nat.totient (p ^ (k + 1))) -
      if p ∣ d then
        1 / ((p : ℝ) * Nat.totient d * Nat.totient (p ^ (k + 1))) else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_odd_primePowers_eq
statement:
theorem sum_odd_primePowers_eq {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (V : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) :
    (∑ b ∈ (oddCutoff V).filter IsPrimePow, f b) =
      ∑ pk ∈ oddPrimePowerPairs V, f (pk.1 ^ pk.2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.totientTypeIMain_eq_primePowerCorrection
statement:
theorem totientTypeIMain_eq_primePowerCorrection (U V : ℕ) :
    totientTypeIMain U V =
      oddMoebiusTotientSum U *
        (∑ b ∈ oddCutoff V, vonMangoldt b / Nat.totient b) -
      ∑ pk ∈ oddPrimePowerPairs V,
        (Real.log pk.1 / ((pk.1 : ℝ) * Nat.totient (pk.1 ^ pk.2))) *
          oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible U pk.1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.totientTypeIMain_eq_sharedPrimeCorrection
statement:
theorem totientTypeIMain_eq_sharedPrimeCorrection (U V : ℕ) :
    totientTypeIMain U V =
      oddMoebiusTotientSum U *
        (∑ b ∈ oddCutoff V, vonMangoldt b / Nat.totient b) -
      ∑ b ∈ oddCutoff V,
        (vonMangoldt b / ((b.minFac : ℝ) * Nat.totient b)) *
          oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible U b.minFac

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.totient_mul_prime_pow_of_dvd
statement:
theorem totient_mul_prime_pow_of_dvd {p d : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpd : p ∣ d)
    (k : ℕ) : Nat.totient (d * p ^ k) = Nat.totient d * p ^ k

statement: theorem isMultiplicative_oddMoebiusTotient : oddMoebiusTotient.IsMultiplicative

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.normalizedMoebius_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedMoebius_apply (n : ℕ) :
    normalizedMoebius n = (μ n : ℝ) / n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSum_eq_smoothingConvolution
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotientSum_eq_smoothingConvolution (U : ℕ) :
    oddMoebiusTotientSum U =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 U, smoothingCorrection d * normalizedMoebiusSum (U / d)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotientSum_eq_sum (U : ℕ) :
    oddMoebiusTotientSum U = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 U, oddMoebiusTotient n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddMoebiusTotient_apply (n : ℕ) :
    oddMoebiusTotient n = if Odd n then (μ n : ℝ) / Nat.totient n else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotient_eq_convolution
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotient_eq_convolution :
    oddMoebiusTotient = smoothingCorrection * normalizedMoebius

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotient_prime_pow_succ_succ
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotient_prime_pow_succ_succ (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    oddMoebiusTotient (p ^ (k + 2)) = 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalNat_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem reciprocalNat_apply (n : ℕ) : reciprocalNat n = 1 / (n : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalNat_mul_normalizedMoebius
statement:
theorem reciprocalNat_mul_normalizedMoebius :
    reciprocalNat * normalizedMoebius = 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedTotientSum_eq_smoothingConvolution
statement:
theorem smoothedTotientSum_eq_smoothingConvolution (U : ℕ) :
    smoothedTotientSum U =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 U, smoothingCorrection d * smoothedMoebiusSum ((U : ℝ) / d)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedTotientSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem smoothedTotientSum_eq_sum (U : ℕ) :
    smoothedTotientSum U =
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 U, oddMoebiusTotient n * Real.log ((U : ℝ) / n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothingCorrection_odd_prime_pow
statement:
theorem smoothingCorrection_odd_prime_pow (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpodd : Odd p) :
    smoothingCorrection (p ^ (k + 1)) =
      -1 / ((p : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((p : ℝ) - 1))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothingCorrection_one
statement: @[simp] theorem smoothingCorrection_one : smoothingCorrection 1 = 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothingCorrection_prime_pow_succ
statement:
theorem smoothingCorrection_prime_pow_succ (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    smoothingCorrection (p ^ (k + 1)) =
      1 / (p : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) + oddMoebiusTotient p / (p : ℝ) ^ k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothingCorrection_two_pow
statement:
theorem smoothingCorrection_two_pow (k : ℕ) :
    smoothingCorrection (2 ^ k) = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_convolution_weight
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_convolution_weight (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (U : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 U, (f * g) n * w n =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 U, f d * ∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 (U / d), g m * w (d * m)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_sum_Ioc_log_mul_le_of_partial_sums
statement:
theorem abs_sum_Ioc_log_mul_le_of_partial_sums (a b U : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hUa : U ≤ a) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, |∑ n ∈ Ioc a t, e n| ≤ M) :
    |∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, Real.log ((n : ℝ) / U) * e n| ≤
      2 * M * Real.log ((b : ℝ) / U)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_sum_Ioc_mul_le_of_partial_sums
statement:
theorem abs_sum_Ioc_mul_le_of_partial_sums (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (w e : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hw0 : 0 ≤ w a)
    (hw : MonotoneOn w (Set.Icc a b))
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, |∑ n ∈ Ioc a t, e n| ≤ M) :
    |∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, w n * e n| ≤ 2 * M * w b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_sum_Ioc_mul_le_total_variation
statement:
theorem abs_sum_Ioc_mul_le_total_variation (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (w e : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, |∑ n ∈ Ioc a t, e n| ≤ M) :
    |∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, w n * e n| ≤
      M * (|w b| + ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, |w (t + 1) - w t|)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.discrete_abel_Ioc
statement:
theorem discrete_abel_Ioc (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (w e : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, w n * e n) =
      w b * (∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, e n) -
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, (w (t + 1) - w t) * (∑ n ∈ Ioc a t, e n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abel_cumulative_Ioc
statement:
theorem abel_cumulative_Ioc (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (w c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, w n * c n) =
      w b * coefficientSum c b - w a * coefficientSum c a -
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, (w (t + 1) - w t) * coefficientSum c t

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_normalizedMoebiusSum_limit_of_mertens_log_six
statement:
theorem exists_normalizedMoebiusSum_limit_of_mertens_log_six (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, |mertensSum t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto normalizedMoebiusSum atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
      ∀ᶠ a : ℕ in atTop,
        |normalizedMoebiusSum a - L| ≤
          (32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_reciprocalCoefficientSum_limit_of_log_six
statement:
theorem exists_reciprocalCoefficientSum_limit_of_log_six (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      |coefficientSum c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (reciprocalCoefficientSum c) atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
      ∀ᶠ a : ℕ in atTop,
        |reciprocalCoefficientSum c a - L| ≤
          (32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_moebius
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_moebius (N : ℕ) :
    reciprocalCoefficientSum (fun n => (μ n : ℝ)) N = normalizedMoebiusSum N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_sub_eq
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_sub_eq (c : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    reciprocalCoefficientSum c b - reciprocalCoefficientSum c a =
      coefficientSum c b / b - coefficientSum c a / a +
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, coefficientSum c t / ((t : ℝ) * (t + 1))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_sub_limit_le_log_five
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_sub_limit_le_log_five (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      |coefficientSum c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : Tendsto (reciprocalCoefficientSum c) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    ∀ᶠ a : ℕ in atTop,
      |reciprocalCoefficientSum c a - L| ≤
        (32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_tail_le_log_five
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_tail_le_log_five (c : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      |coefficientSum c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    |reciprocalCoefficientSum c b - reciprocalCoefficientSum c a| ≤
      (32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_tail_le_log_six
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_tail_le_log_six (c : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      |coefficientSum c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    |reciprocalCoefficientSum c b - reciprocalCoefficientSum c a| ≤
      2 * K / (Real.log a) ^ 6 + 32 * K / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocal_log_six_kernel_le
statement:
theorem reciprocal_log_six_kernel_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    1 / ((x + 1) * (Real.log x) ^ 6) ≤
      32 * (1 / (Real.log x) ^ 5 - 1 / (Real.log (x + 1)) ^ 5)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedMoebiusSum_eq_log_mul_sub_moment
statement:
theorem smoothedMoebiusSum_eq_log_mul_sub_moment {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    smoothedMoebiusSum x =
      Real.log x * normalizedMoebiusSum ⌊x⌋₊ - moebiusLogMoment ⌊x⌋₊

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_reciprocal_log_six_kernel_le
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocal_log_six_kernel_le (a b : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ico a b, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log n) ^ 6)) ≤
      32 / (Real.log a) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_log_mul_floor_of_mul_log_sq
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_mul_floor_of_mul_log_sq (F : ℕ → ℝ)

statement:

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_normalizedMoebiusSum_mul_log_sq_of_mertens_log_six
statement:
theorem tendsto_normalizedMoebiusSum_mul_log_sq_of_mertens_log_six
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, |mertensSum t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6)
    (hzero : Tendsto normalizedMoebiusSum atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => normalizedMoebiusSum n * (Real.log (n + 1)) ^ 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_smoothedMoebiusSum_of_ordinary_inputs
statement:
theorem tendsto_smoothedMoebiusSum_of_ordinary_inputs
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, |mertensSum t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_harmonic_sub_log_sub_eulerMascheroni_le
statement:
theorem abs_harmonic_sub_log_sub_eulerMascheroni_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.coefficientSum_primeErrorCoefficient
statement:
theorem coefficientSum_primeErrorCoefficient (N : ℕ) :
    coefficientSum primeErrorCoefficient N = Chebyshev.psi (N : ℝ) - N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_primeReciprocalSum_center_bound_of_psi_log_six
statement:
theorem exists_primeReciprocalSum_center_bound_of_psi_log_six
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |Chebyshev.psi (N : ℝ) - (N : ℝ)| ≤ K * N / (Real.log N) ^ 6) :
    ∃ c : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => primeReciprocalSum N - Real.log N) atTop (nhds c) ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        |primeReciprocalSum N - Real.log N - c| ≤
          ((32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K + 1) / (Real.log N) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_primeReciprocalSum_center_of_psi_log_six
statement:
theorem exists_primeReciprocalSum_center_of_psi_log_six
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |Chebyshev.psi (N : ℝ) - (N : ℝ)| ≤ K * N / (Real.log N) ^ 6) :
    ∃ c : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => primeReciprocalSum N - Real.log N) atTop (nhds c) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        |primeReciprocalSum N - Real.log N - c| ≤ C / (Real.log N) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reciprocalCoefficientSum_primeErrorCoefficient
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoefficientSum_primeErrorCoefficient (N : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_centeredSelbergCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem abs_centeredSelbergCoefficient_le (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    |centeredSelbergCoefficient c n| ≤
      (vonMangoldt * vonMangoldt : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) n +

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_floor_le
statement:
theorem centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_floor_le (c x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_le
statement:
theorem centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_le (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    centeredSelbergReciprocalMass c N ≤
      (primeReciprocalSum N) ^ 2 + Real.log N * primeReciprocalSum N +

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_le_log_sq
statement:
theorem centeredSelbergReciprocalMass_le_log_sq (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

      selbergReciprocalMassConstant c * (2 + Real.log N) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.orderEmbOfFin_ge_mul_of_separated
statement:
theorem orderEmbOfFin_ge_mul_of_separated (s : Finset ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hbase : ∀ x ∈ s, δ ≤ x)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x < y → δ ≤ y - x) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_reciprocal_abs_le_of_separated
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocal_abs_le_of_separated (s : Finset ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbase : ∀ x ∈ s, δ ≤ |x|)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → δ ≤ |x - y|) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, 1 / |x|) ≤ 2 * (harmonic s.card : ℝ) / δ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_reciprocal_le_harmonic_of_separated
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocal_le_harmonic_of_separated (s : Finset ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbase : ∀ x ∈ s, δ ≤ x)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x < y → δ ≤ y - x) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, 1 / x) ≤ (harmonic s.card : ℝ) / δ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additive_kernel_row_le_of_separated
statement:
theorem additive_kernel_row_le_of_separated {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (θ : ι → ℝ) (M N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      δ ≤ dist (θ i : UnitAddCircle) (θ j : UnitAddCircle))
    (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, additivePhase (n * (θ i - θ j))‖) ≤
      ((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (harmonic s.card : ℝ) / δ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additive_large_sieve_of_separated
statement:
theorem additive_large_sieve_of_separated {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (θ : ι → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (M N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      δ ≤ dist (θ i : UnitAddCircle) (θ j : UnitAddCircle)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n * additivePhase (n * θ i)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (harmonic s.card : ℝ) / δ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.additive_large_sieve_of_separated_log
statement:
theorem additive_large_sieve_of_separated_log {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (θ : ι → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (M N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      δ ≤ dist (θ i : UnitAddCircle) (θ j : UnitAddCircle)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n * additivePhase (n * θ i)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (1 + Real.log s.card) / δ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_reciprocal_unitAddCircle_dist_le
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocal_unitAddCircle_dist_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (θ : ι → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      δ ≤ dist (θ i : UnitAddCircle) (θ j : UnitAddCircle))
    (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_normalized_holomorphic_log_on_ball
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_holomorphic_log_on_ball (g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball c R))
    (hgn : ∀ z ∈ ball c R, g z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ h (ball c R) ∧ h c = 0 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball c R, Complex.exp (h z) = g z / g c) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball c R, deriv h z = deriv g z / g z)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_analytic_le_of_re_le_on_ball
statement:
theorem norm_analytic_le_of_re_le_on_ball {h : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {A : ℝ}

    (hc : h c = 0) (hre : ∀ w ∈ ball c (5 / 4), (h w).re ≤ A)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_logDerivative_le_of_nonvanishing_on_ball

theorem norm_logDerivative_le_of_nonvanishing_on_ball {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {M : ℝ}

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.zero_removal_log_budget_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_additive_factorization
statement:
theorem primitive_character_additive_factorization {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar * (∑ n ∈ s, a n * χ⁻¹ n) =

          ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * χ⁻¹ n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ u : (ZMod q)ˣ, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * ZMod.stdAddChar ((u : ZMod q) * (n : ZMod q))‖ ^ 2

    ‖∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 t, (Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ≤

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_typeI_log_character_le

      ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 (T / m), (Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ≤
      (2 * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q) * Real.log T) *

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_typeI_log_character_le_uniform

theorem norm_sum_typeI_log_character_le_uniform {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : Finset ℕ)

statement:
theorem characterPsi_eq_vaughan {q : ℕ} (U V t : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterPsi t χ =
      (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 t, ((moebiusLow U * ArithmeticFunction.log) n : ℂ) * χ n) -
      (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 t, ((vaughanCoefficient U V * ζ) n : ℂ) * χ n) +
        characterPsi (min t V) χ + characterVaughanII U V t χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanII_eq_double_sum
statement:
theorem characterVaughanII_eq_double_sum {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    characterVaughanII U V t χ =
      ∑ m ∈ Ioc U T, ∑ n ∈ Ioc V T with m * n ≤ t,
        ((μ m : ℝ) : ℂ) * (vaughanBeta V n : ℂ) * χ (m * n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanII_eq_masked_double_sum
statement:
theorem characterVaughanII_eq_masked_double_sum {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    characterVaughanII U V t χ =
      ∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 T with m * n ≤ t,
        (if U < m ∧ m ≤ T then ((μ m : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0) *
          (if V < n ∧ n ≤ T then (vaughanBeta V n : ℂ) else 0) * χ (m * n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanII_eq_pair_sum

theorem characterVaughanII_eq_pair_sum {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)

    characterVaughanII U V t χ =
      ∑ dr ∈ ((Ioc U T).product (Ioc V T)).filter (fun dr => dr.1 * dr.2 ≤ t),
        ((μ dr.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (vaughanBeta V dr.2 : ℂ) * χ (dr.1 * dr.2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_eq_dyadic_of_support
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_eq_dyadic_of_support {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : ℕ → α) (T : ℕ) (hf : ∀ n, T < n → f n = 0) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 T, f n) =
      ∑ k ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T), ∑ n ∈ Ico (2 ^ k) (2 ^ k + 2 ^ k), f n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_product_eq_dyadic_of_support
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_product_eq_dyadic_of_support {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → α) (T : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ m n, T < m ∨ T < n → f m n = 0) :
    (∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 T, f m n) =
      ∑ k ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T), ∑ j ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T),
        ∑ m ∈ Ico (2 ^ k) (2 ^ k + 2 ^ k),
          ∑ n ∈ Ico (2 ^ j) (2 ^ j + 2 ^ j), f m n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.rational_frequency_dist_ge
statement:
theorem rational_frequency_dist_ge (a b : ℤ) (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hne : (((a : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) ≠ (((b : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) :
    (1 : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * r) ≤
      dist ((((a : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) ((((b : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.rational_frequency_dist_ge_inv_sq
statement:
theorem rational_frequency_dist_ge_inv_sq (a b : ℤ) (q r Q : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (hqQ : q ≤ Q) (hrQ : r ≤ Q)
    (hne : (((a : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) ≠ (((b : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) :
    (1 : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      dist ((((a : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) ((((b : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.reduced_rational_frequency_unique
statement:
theorem reduced_rational_frequency_unique (a b q r : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : a < q) (hb : b < r)
    (haq : Nat.Coprime a q) (hbr : Nat.Coprime b r)
    (heq : (((a : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) = (((b : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) :
    q = r ∧ a = b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.unit_rational_frequency_dist_ge_inv_sq
statement:
theorem unit_rational_frequency_dist_ge_inv_sq {q r : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero r]
    (Q : ℕ) (hqQ : q ≤ Q) (hrQ : r ≤ Q) (u : (ZMod q)ˣ) (v : (ZMod r)ˣ)
    (hne : ¬ (q = r ∧ (u : ZMod q).val = (v : ZMod r).val)) :
    (1 : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ dist (ZMod.toAddCircle (u : ZMod q)) (ZMod.toAddCircle (v : ZMod r))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.unit_rational_frequency_eq_iff
statement:
theorem unit_rational_frequency_eq_iff {q r : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero r]
    (u : (ZMod q)ˣ) (v : (ZMod r)ˣ) :
    ZMod.toAddCircle (u : ZMod q) = ZMod.toAddCircle (v : ZMod r) ↔
      q = r ∧ (u : ZMod q).val = (v : ZMod r).val

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_rationalFrequencyFamily
statement:
theorem card_rationalFrequencyFamily (Q : ℕ) :
    (rationalFrequencyFamily Q).card = ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, Nat.totient q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.harmonic_totient_sum_le_log
statement:
theorem harmonic_totient_sum_le_log (Q : ℕ) :
    (harmonic (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, Nat.totient q) : ℝ) ≤
      1 + 2 * Real.log ((Q : ℝ) + 1)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_large_sieve
statement:
theorem primitive_character_large_sieve (Q M N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n * χ⁻¹ n‖ ^ 2)) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (harmonic (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, Nat.totient q) : ℝ)) *
          ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_large_sieve_log
statement:
theorem primitive_character_large_sieve_log (Q M N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n * χ⁻¹ n‖ ^ 2)) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (1 + 2 * Real.log ((Q : ℝ) + 1))) *
          ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.rationalFrequencyFamily_separated
statement:
theorem rationalFrequencyFamily_separated (Q : ℕ)
    (i : Σ q : ℕ, (ZMod q)ˣ) (hi : i ∈ rationalFrequencyFamily Q)
    (j : Σ q : ℕ, (ZMod q)ˣ) (hj : j ∈ rationalFrequencyFamily Q)
    (hne : i ≠ j) :
    (1 : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      dist (rationalFrequency i : UnitAddCircle) (rationalFrequency j : UnitAddCircle)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.rational_additive_large_sieve
statement:
theorem rational_additive_large_sieve (Q M N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, ∑ u : (ZMod q)ˣ,
      ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n *
        additivePhase ((n : ℝ) * ((u : ZMod q).val / (q : ℝ)))‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (harmonic (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, Nat.totient q) : ℝ)) *
          ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.rational_additive_large_sieve_log
statement:
theorem rational_additive_large_sieve_log (Q M N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, ∑ u : (ZMod q)ˣ,
      ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M N, a n *
        additivePhase ((n : ℝ) * ((u : ZMod q).val / (q : ℝ)))‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((N - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (1 + 2 * Real.log ((Q : ℝ) + 1))) *
          ∑ n ∈ Ico M N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.stdAddChar_mul_eq_additivePhase
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_mul_eq_additivePhase {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (u : (ZMod q)ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar ((u : ZMod q) * (n : ZMod q)) =
      additivePhase ((n : ℝ) * ((u : ZMod q).val / (q : ℝ)))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_totient_Icc_le_sq
statement:
theorem sum_totient_Icc_le_sq (Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, Nat.totient q) ≤ Q ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.character_rectangular_sum_eq
statement:
theorem character_rectangular_sum_eq {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (s t : Finset ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ m ∈ s, ∑ n ∈ t, a m * b n * χ (m * n)) =
      (∑ m ∈ s, a m * χ m) * ∑ n ∈ t, b n * χ n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (w f g : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i * g i) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * g i ^ 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicEnergy_nonneg
statement: theorem dyadicEnergy_nonneg (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ dyadicEnergy f M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_dyadicBlock_sq_le_energy
statement:
theorem norm_dyadicBlock_sq_le_energy (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ dyadicEnergy f M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_prefix_sq_le_dyadicEnergy
statement:
theorem norm_prefix_sq_le_dyadicEnergy (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k t : ℕ)
    (hMt : M ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M t, f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * dyadicEnergy f M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_dyadicEnergy_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_dyadicEnergy_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hLS : ∀ u v : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico u v, f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((v - u : ℕ) : ℝ) + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico u v, e n) (M k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * dyadicEnergy (f i) M k) ≤
      ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), e n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_prefix_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_prefix_sq_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (f : ι → ℕ → ℂ)
    (e : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hLS : ∀ u v : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico u v, f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((v - u : ℕ) : ℝ) + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico u v, e n)
    (M k : ℕ) (t : ι → ℕ) (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, M ≤ t i ∧ t i ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico M (t i), f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k + A) *
        ∑ n ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), e n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_dyadicIntervalCover_le
statement:
theorem card_dyadicIntervalCover_le (M k u v : ℕ)
    (hMu : M ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    (dyadicIntervalCover M k u v).card ≤ 2 * (k + 1)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_dyadicIntervalCover_prefix_le
statement:
theorem card_dyadicIntervalCover_prefix_le (M k v : ℕ)
    (hMv : M ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    (dyadicIntervalCover M k M v).card ≤ k + 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_dyadicIntervalCover_suffix_le
statement:
theorem card_dyadicIntervalCover_suffix_le (M k u : ℕ)
    (hMu : M ≤ u) (hu : u ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    (dyadicIntervalCover M k u (M + 2 ^ k)).card ≤ k + 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicIntervalCover_disjoint_of_intervals
statement:
theorem dyadicIntervalCover_disjoint_of_intervals (M k u v M' k' u' v' : ℕ)
    (hMu : M ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k)
    (hMu' : M' ≤ u') (huv' : u' ≤ v') (hv' : v' ≤ M' + 2 ^ k')
    (hdis : Disjoint (Ico u v) (Ico u' v')) :
    Disjoint (dyadicIntervalCover M k u v) (dyadicIntervalCover M' k' u' v')

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicIntervalCover_eq_empty
statement:
theorem dyadicIntervalCover_eq_empty (M k u v : ℕ) (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    dyadicIntervalCover M k u v = ∅

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicIntervalCover_full
statement:
theorem dyadicIntervalCover_full (M k : ℕ) :
    dyadicIntervalCover M k M (M + 2 ^ k) = {(M, k)}

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicIntervalCover_subset_tree
statement:
theorem dyadicIntervalCover_subset_tree (M k u v : ℕ) :
    dyadicIntervalCover M k u v ⊆ dyadicTreeBlocks M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicTreeBlocks_children_disjoint
statement:
theorem dyadicTreeBlocks_children_disjoint (M k : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (dyadicTreeBlocks M k) (dyadicTreeBlocks (M + 2 ^ k) k)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicTreeBlocks_root_not_mem_children
statement:
theorem dyadicTreeBlocks_root_not_mem_children (M k : ℕ) :
    (M, k + 1) ∉ dyadicTreeBlocks M k ∪ dyadicTreeBlocks (M + 2 ^ k) k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mem_dyadicIntervalCover_bounds
statement:
theorem mem_dyadicIntervalCover_bounds (M k u v : ℕ)
    (hMu : M ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k)
    (p : ℕ × ℕ) (hp : p ∈ dyadicIntervalCover M k u v) :
    u ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 ≤ v ∧ p.2 ≤ k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mem_dyadicTreeBlocks_bounds
statement:
theorem mem_dyadicTreeBlocks_bounds (M k : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ dyadicTreeBlocks M k) :
    M ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 ≤ M + 2 ^ k ∧ p.2 ≤ k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_interval_sq_le_dyadicCover
statement:
theorem norm_interval_sq_le_dyadicCover (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k u v : ℕ)
    (hMu : M ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Ico u v, f n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) *
        ∑ p ∈ dyadicIntervalCover M k u v, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2), f n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, z i‖ ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖z i‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_disjoint_intervals_sq_le_dyadicEnergy
statement:
theorem sum_disjoint_intervals_sq_le_dyadicEnergy {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (u v : ι → ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k : ℕ)
    (hvalid : ∀ i ∈ s, M ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ v i ∧ v i ≤ M + 2 ^ k)
    (hdis : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Ico (u i) (v i)) (Ico (u j) (v j))) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (u i) (v i), f n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) * dyadicEnergy f M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_disjoint_intervals_sq_le_tree
statement:
theorem sum_disjoint_intervals_sq_le_tree {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (u v : ι → ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k : ℕ)
    (hvalid : ∀ i ∈ s, M ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ v i ∧ v i ≤ M + 2 ^ k)
    (hdis : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Ico (u i) (v i)) (Ico (u j) (v j))) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (u i) (v i), f n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) *
        ∑ p ∈ dyadicTreeBlocks M k, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2), f n‖ ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_dyadicIntervalCover
statement:
theorem sum_dyadicIntervalCover {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (f : ℕ → α)
    (M k u v : ℕ) (hMu : M ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ M + 2 ^ k) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicIntervalCover M k u v, ∑ n ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2), f n) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico u v, f n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_dyadicTreeBlocks_eq_energy
statement:
theorem sum_dyadicTreeBlocks_eq_energy (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M k : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicTreeBlocks M k, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2), f n‖ ^ 2) =
      dyadicEnergy f M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_disjoint_intervals_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_disjoint_intervals_sq_le {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (t : ι → Finset κ) (u v : ι → κ → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (f : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hLS : ∀ a b : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico a b, f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((b - a : ℕ) : ℝ) + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico a b, e n)
    (M k : ℕ)
    (hvalid : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t i,
      M ≤ u i j ∧ u i j ≤ v i j ∧ v i j ≤ M + 2 ^ k)
    (hdis : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t i, ∀ j' ∈ t i, j ≠ j' →
      Disjoint (Ico (u i j) (v i j)) (Ico (u i j') (v i j'))) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ t i, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (u i j) (v i j), f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k + A) *
        ∑ n ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), e n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveCharacterWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem primitiveCharacterWeight_nonneg (p : Σ q : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    0 ≤ primitiveCharacterWeight p

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseDetail_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem dyadicStaircaseDetail_const (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (c M k : ℕ) :
    dyadicStaircaseDetail a b (fun _ => c) M k = 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.filter_Ico_productCutoff_eq
statement:
theorem filter_Ico_productCutoff_eq (T N K m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (Ico N (N + K)).filter (fun n => m * n ≤ T) =
      Ico N (productCutoffBoundary T N K m)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.le_productCutoffBoundary
statement:
theorem le_productCutoffBoundary (T N K m : ℕ) :
    N ≤ productCutoffBoundary T N K m

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.lt_productCutoffBoundary_iff
statement:
theorem lt_productCutoffBoundary_iff (T N K m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hn : n ∈ Ico N (N + K)) :
    n < productCutoffBoundary T N K m ↔ m * n ≤ T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.productCutoffBoundary_antitone
statement:
theorem productCutoffBoundary_antitone (T N K m r : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmr : m ≤ r) :
    productCutoffBoundary T N K r ≤ productCutoffBoundary T N K m

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.productCutoffBoundary_antitoneOn
statement:
theorem productCutoffBoundary_antitoneOn (T N K M R : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    AntitoneOn (productCutoffBoundary T N K) (Set.Ico M R)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.productCutoffBoundary_le
statement:
theorem productCutoffBoundary_le (T N K m : ℕ) :
    productCutoffBoundary T N K m ≤ N + K

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_dyadic_productCutoff_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dyadic_productCutoff_eq (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (T M N K k : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    (∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k),
      ∑ n ∈ Ico N (N + K) with m * n ≤ T, a m * b n) =
      (∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m) *
        (∑ n ∈ Ico N (productCutoffBoundary T N K (M + 2 ^ k - 1)), b n) +
          dyadicStaircaseDetail a b (productCutoffBoundary T N K) M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_dyadic_staircase_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dyadic_staircase_eq (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M N k : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), N ≤ F m)
    (hF : AntitoneOn F (Set.Ico M (M + 2 ^ k))) :
    (∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m * (∑ n ∈ Ico N (F m), b n)) =
      (∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m) *
        (∑ n ∈ Ico N (F (M + 2 ^ k - 1)), b n) +
          dyadicStaircaseDetail a b F M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_correction_disjoint
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_correction_disjoint (M k ℓ : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : AntitoneOn F (Set.Ico M (M + 2 ^ k)))
    (p : ℕ × ℕ) (hp : p ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ)
    (q : ℕ × ℕ) (hq : q ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    Disjoint
      (Ico (F (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1)) (F (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1)))
      (Ico (F (q.1 + 2 ^ q.2 - 1)) (F (q.1 + 2 ^ (q.2 - 1) - 1)))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_correction_valid
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_correction_valid (M k ℓ N j : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : AntitoneOn F (Set.Ico M (M + 2 ^ k)))
    (hbound : ∀ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), N ≤ F m ∧ F m ≤ N + 2 ^ j)
    (p : ℕ × ℕ) (hp : p ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ) :
    N ≤ F (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1) ∧
      F (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1) ≤ F (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1) ∧
        F (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1) ≤ N + 2 ^ j

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_endpoint_mem
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_endpoint_mem (M k ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ) :
    (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1) ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k) ∧
      (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1) ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k) ∧
        p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1 ≤ p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_halfLength
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_halfLength (M k ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ) :
    (2 : ℕ) ^ (p.2 - 1) = 2 ^ ℓ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_half_le_length
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_half_le_length (M k ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ dyadicStaircaseLevel M k ℓ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseLevel_left_disjoint
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_left_disjoint (M k ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)

statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseLevel_left_valid (M k ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ)

statement:
theorem dyadicTreeBlocks_same_height_disjoint (M k : ℕ) (p q : ℕ × ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseCorrection_leaf

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_levels
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_levels (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M k : ℕ) :
    dyadicStaircaseDetail a b F M k =
      ∑ ℓ ∈ range k,
        ∑ p ∈ (dyadicTreeBlocks M k).filter (fun p => p.2 = ℓ + 1),
          dyadicStaircaseCorrection a b F p

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_levels_explicit
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_levels_explicit
    (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M k : ℕ) :
    dyadicStaircaseDetail a b F M k =
      ∑ ℓ ∈ range k,
        ∑ p ∈ (dyadicTreeBlocks M k).filter (fun p => p.2 = ℓ + 1),
          (∑ m ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ ℓ), a m) *
            (∑ n ∈ Ico (F (p.1 + 2 ^ (ℓ + 1) - 1)) (F (p.1 + 2 ^ ℓ - 1)), b n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_tree
statement:
theorem dyadicStaircaseDetail_eq_sum_tree (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M k : ℕ) :
    dyadicStaircaseDetail a b F M k =
      ∑ p ∈ dyadicTreeBlocks M k, dyadicStaircaseCorrection a b F p

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_dyadicStaircaseDetail_le_levels
statement:
theorem norm_dyadicStaircaseDetail_le_levels
    (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M k : ℕ) :
    ‖dyadicStaircaseDetail a b F M k‖ ≤
      ∑ ℓ ∈ range k,
        ∑ p ∈ (dyadicTreeBlocks M k).filter (fun p => p.2 = ℓ + 1),
          ‖∑ m ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1)), a m‖ *
            ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (F (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1))
              (F (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1)), b n‖

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_sum_dyadic_staircase_le_levels
statement:
theorem norm_sum_dyadic_staircase_le_levels (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (M N k : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), N ≤ F m)
    (hF : AntitoneOn F (Set.Ico M (M + 2 ^ k))) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m * (∑ n ∈ Ico N (F m), b n)‖ ≤
      ‖∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m‖ *
        ‖∑ n ∈ Ico N (F (M + 2 ^ k - 1)), b n‖ +
      ∑ ℓ ∈ range k,
        ∑ p ∈ (dyadicTreeBlocks M k).filter (fun p => p.2 = ℓ + 1),
          ‖∑ m ∈ Ico p.1 (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1)), a m‖ *
            ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (F (p.1 + 2 ^ p.2 - 1))
              (F (p.1 + 2 ^ (p.2 - 1) - 1)), b n‖

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_fixed_disjoint_intervals_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_fixed_disjoint_intervals_sq_le {ι κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (J : Finset κ) (u v : κ → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (f : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hLS : ∀ a b : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico a b, f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((b - a : ℕ) : ℝ) + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico a b, e n)
    (M R : ℕ)
    (hvalid : ∀ j ∈ J, M ≤ u j ∧ u j ≤ v j ∧ v j ≤ R)
    (hdis : ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ j' ∈ J, j ≠ j' →
      Disjoint (Ico (u j) (v j)) (Ico (u j') (v j'))) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J, ‖∑ n ∈ Ico (u j) (v j), f i n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((R - M : ℕ) : ℝ) + A) * ∑ n ∈ Ico M R, e n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sqrt_baseline_add_levels_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_baseline_add_levels_le (EA EB : ℝ) (_hEA : 0 ≤ EA) (hEB : 0 ≤ EB)
    (k j : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt EA * Real.sqrt (((j : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * EB) +
        (k : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt EA * Real.sqrt ((2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * EB)) ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * Real.sqrt EA * Real.sqrt EB

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_norm_mul_le
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_norm_mul_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → ℂ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (EA EB : ℝ)
    (hA : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖A i‖ ^ 2) ≤ EA)
    (hB : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖B i‖ ^ 2) ≤ EB) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_norm_sum_mul_le

    (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Finset κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → κ → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (EA EB : ℝ)
    (hA : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, ‖A i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ EA)
    (hB : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, ‖B i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ EB) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ‖∑ j ∈ J i, A i j * B i j‖) ≤

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {ι κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Finset κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (f g : ι → κ → ℝ)

    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, f i j * g i j) ≤

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_sum_norm_mul_le
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_sum_norm_mul_le {ι κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Finset κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → κ → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (EA EB : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_sum_norm_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_sum_norm_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {ι κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Finset κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → κ → ℂ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_sum_norm_rectangular_le
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_sum_norm_rectangular_le {ι κ α β : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Finset κ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (U : ι → κ → Finset α) (V : ι → κ → Finset β)
    (a : ι → α → ℂ) (b : ι → β → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (EA EB : ℝ)
    (hA : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, ‖∑ m ∈ U i j, a i m‖ ^ 2) ≤ EA)
    (hB : (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, ‖∑ n ∈ V i j, b i n‖ ^ 2) ≤ EB) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * ∑ j ∈ J i, ‖∑ m ∈ U i j, ∑ n ∈ V i j, a i m * b i n‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt EA * Real.sqrt EB

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_dyadic_staircase_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_dyadic_staircase_le {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ w x)
    (a b : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (ea eb : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hea : ∀ n, 0 ≤ ea n) (heb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ eb n)
    (hLSa : ∀ u v : ℕ, (∑ x ∈ s, w x * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico u v, a x n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((v - u : ℕ) : ℝ) + C) * ∑ n ∈ Ico u v, ea n)
    (hLSb : ∀ u v : ℕ, (∑ x ∈ s, w x * ‖∑ n ∈ Ico u v, b x n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (((v - u : ℕ) : ℝ) + C) * ∑ n ∈ Ico u v, eb n)
    (M N k j : ℕ) (F : ι → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ s, AntitoneOn (F x) (Set.Ico M (M + 2 ^ k)))
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k),
      N ≤ F x m ∧ F x m ≤ N + 2 ^ j) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, w x *
      ‖∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a x m * (∑ n ∈ Ico N (F x m), b x n)‖) ≤
      (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) *
        Real.sqrt (((2 : ℝ) ^ k + C) * ∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), ea m) *
          Real.sqrt (((2 : ℝ) ^ j + C) * ∑ n ∈ Ico N (N + 2 ^ j), eb n)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterProductCutoffSum_eq_baseline_add_detail
statement:
theorem characterProductCutoffSum_eq_baseline_add_detail {q : ℕ}
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (M N k j t : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    characterProductCutoffSum χ a b M N k j t =
      (∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), a m * χ m) *
        (∑ n ∈ Ico N (productCutoffBoundary t N (2 ^ j) (M + 2 ^ k - 1)), b n * χ n) +
          dyadicStaircaseDetail (fun m => a m * χ m) (fun n => b n * χ n)
            (productCutoffBoundary t N (2 ^ j)) M k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterProductCutoffSum_eq_staircase
statement:
theorem characterProductCutoffSum_eq_staircase {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (M N k j t : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    characterProductCutoffSum χ a b M N k j t =
      ∑ m ∈ Ico M (M + 2 ^ k), (a m * χ m) *
        ∑ n ∈ Ico N (productCutoffBoundary t N (2 ^ j) m), b n * χ n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.activeVaughanBoxes_bounds
statement:
theorem activeVaughanBoxes_bounds (U V T k j : ℕ)
    (h : (k, j) ∈ activeVaughanBoxes U V T) :
    (U : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k ∧ (V : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ j ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ k * 2 ^ j ≤ (T : ℝ) ∧
        k + 1 ≤ dyadicNatDepth T ∧ j + 1 ≤ dyadicNatDepth T

        U < 2 ^ (k + 1) ∧ V < 2 ^ (j + 1) ∧ 2 ^ k * 2 ^ j ≤ T

    characterVaughanIIMax U V T χ ≤
      ∑ p ∈ activeVaughanBoxes U V T,
        characterProductCutoffMax χ (vaughanBoxA U T) (vaughanBoxB V T)

theorem characterVaughanII_eq_active_boxes {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)

    characterVaughanII U V t χ =
      ∑ p ∈ activeVaughanBoxes U V T,
        characterProductCutoffSum χ (vaughanBoxA U T) (vaughanBoxB V T)
          (2 ^ p.1) (2 ^ p.2) p.1 p.2 t

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanII_eq_dyadic_boxes
statement:
theorem characterVaughanII_eq_dyadic_boxes {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    characterVaughanII U V t χ =
      ∑ k ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T), ∑ j ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T),
        characterProductCutoffSum χ (vaughanBoxA U T) (vaughanBoxB V T)
          (2 ^ k) (2 ^ j) k j t

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanII_le_active_max
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanII_le_active_max {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖characterVaughanII U V t χ‖ ≤
      ∑ p ∈ activeVaughanBoxes U V T,
        characterProductCutoffMax χ (vaughanBoxA U T) (vaughanBoxB V T)
          (2 ^ p.1) (2 ^ p.2) p.1 p.2 T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanII_le_max
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanII_le_max {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖characterVaughanII U V t χ‖ ≤ characterVaughanIIMax U V T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterPsi_eq_vaughan_types
statement:
theorem characterPsi_eq_vaughan_types {q : ℕ} (U V t : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterPsi t χ = characterVaughanI1 U t χ - characterVaughanI2 U V t χ +
      characterPsi (min t V) χ + characterVaughanII U V t χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI1_eq_factor_sum
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI1_eq_factor_sum {q : ℕ} (U t : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterVaughanI1 U t χ =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 U, ((μ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ d *
        ∑ r ∈ Ioc 0 (t / d), (Real.log (r : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ r

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI2_eq_factor_sum
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI2_eq_factor_sum {q : ℕ} (U V t : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterVaughanI2 U V t χ =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 (U * V), (vaughanCoefficient U V d : ℂ) * χ d *
        ∑ r ∈ Ioc 0 (t / d), χ r

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_character_convolution_eq_factor_sum
statement:
theorem sum_character_convolution_eq_factor_sum {q : ℕ}
    (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (K t : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hf : ∀ d, K < d → f d = 0) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 t, ((f * g) n : ℂ) * χ n) =
      ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 K, (f d : ℂ) * χ d *
        ∑ r ∈ Ioc 0 (t / d), (g r : ℂ) * χ r

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterPsiMax_le_vaughan
statement:
theorem characterPsiMax_le_vaughan (U V T : ℕ) {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterPsiMax T χ ≤ characterVaughanI1Max U T χ + characterVaughanI2Max U V T χ +
      (V : ℝ) * Real.log V + characterVaughanIIMax U V T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI1Max_le
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI1Max_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (U T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    characterVaughanI1Max U T χ ≤
      2 * (U : ℝ) * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q) * Real.log T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI1Max_nonneg
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI1Max_nonneg {q : ℕ} (U T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    0 ≤ characterVaughanI1Max U T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI2Max_le
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI2Max_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (U V T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    characterVaughanI2Max U V T χ ≤
      ((U * V : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (U * V : ℕ) * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterVaughanI2Max_nonneg
statement:
theorem characterVaughanI2Max_nonneg {q : ℕ} (U V T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    0 ≤ characterVaughanI2Max U V T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanI1_le
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanI1_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (U t T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖characterVaughanI1 U t χ‖ ≤
      2 * (U : ℝ) * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q) * Real.log T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanI1_le_max
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanI1_le_max {q : ℕ} (U t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖characterVaughanI1 U t χ‖ ≤ characterVaughanI1Max U T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanI2_le
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanI2_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (U V t : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ‖characterVaughanI2 U V t χ‖ ≤
      ((U * V : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (U * V : ℕ) * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_characterVaughanI2_le_max
statement:
theorem norm_characterVaughanI2_le_max {q : ℕ} (U V t T : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖characterVaughanI2 U V t χ‖ ≤ characterVaughanI2Max U V T χ

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_norm_moebius_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_moebius_Ioc_le (U : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 U, ‖((μ d : ℝ) : ℂ)‖) ≤ (U : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_norm_vaughanCoefficient_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_vaughanCoefficient_Ioc_le (U V : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 (U * V), ‖(vaughanCoefficient U V d : ℂ)‖) ≤
      (U * V : ℕ) * Real.log (U * V : ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinear_box_polynomial_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_box_polynomial_le (M N U V T C : ℝ)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hUM : U ≤ M) (hV : 0 < V) (hVN : V ≤ N)
    (hMN : M * N ≤ T) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    Real.sqrt (M * N * (M + C) * (N + C)) ≤
      T + Real.sqrt C * T * (1 / Real.sqrt U + 1 / Real.sqrt V) + C * Real.sqrt T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinear_box_polynomial_le_log_factor
statement:
theorem bilinear_box_polynomial_le_log_factor (M N U V T Q L : ℝ)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hUM : U ≤ M) (hV : 0 < V) (hVN : V ≤ N)
    (hMN : M * N ≤ T) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    Real.sqrt (M * N * (M + Q ^ 2 * L) * (N + Q ^ 2 * L)) ≤
      L * (T + Q * T * (1 / Real.sqrt U + 1 / Real.sqrt V) + Q ^ 2 * Real.sqrt T)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinear_box_sqrt_le_expansion
statement:
theorem bilinear_box_sqrt_le_expansion (M N C : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    Real.sqrt (M * N * (M + C) * (N + C)) ≤
      M * N + Real.sqrt C * (M * Real.sqrt N + Real.sqrt M * N) +
        C * Real.sqrt (M * N)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mul_sqrt_le_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem mul_sqrt_le_div_sqrt (M N V T : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hV : 0 < V) (hVN : V ≤ N) (hMN : M * N ≤ T) :
    M * Real.sqrt N ≤ T / Real.sqrt V

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sqrt_mul_add_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_add_le (M C : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    Real.sqrt (M * (M + C)) ≤ M + Real.sqrt C * Real.sqrt M

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterLargeSieveConstant_dyadic
statement:
theorem characterLargeSieveConstant_dyadic (Q M k : ℕ) :
    characterLargeSieveConstant Q M (M + 2 ^ k) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k + characterLargeSieveOffset Q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterLargeSieveOffset_nonneg
statement: theorem characterLargeSieveOffset_nonneg (Q : ℕ) : 0 ≤ characterLargeSieveOffset Q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.one_le_characterLargeSieveLogFactor
statement: theorem one_le_characterLargeSieveLogFactor (Q : ℕ) : 1 ≤ characterLargeSieveLogFactor Q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sqrt_box_energy_mul_eq
statement:
theorem sqrt_box_energy_mul_eq (M N C L : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    Real.sqrt ((M + C) * M) * Real.sqrt ((N + C) * (N * L ^ 2)) =
      L * Real.sqrt (M * N * (M + C) * (N + C))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_dirichletCharacter_eq_totient
statement:
theorem card_dirichletCharacter_eq_totient (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_primitiveCharacters_le_totient
statement:
theorem card_primitiveCharacters_le_totient (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_modulus_Icc_two_le_sq
statement:
theorem sum_modulus_Icc_two_le_sq (R : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ)) ≤ (R : ℝ) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_modulus_sqrt_log_le
statement:
theorem sum_modulus_sqrt_log_le (R : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) * Real.sqrt q * (1 + Real.log q)) ≤

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_primitive_card_le_sq
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_primitive_card_le_sq (R : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (((univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive)).card : ℝ)) ≤
        (R : ℝ) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_primitive_count_le_sq
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_primitive_count_le_sq (R : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ _χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive), (1 : ℝ))) ≤
        (R : ℝ) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_primitive_le_const
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_primitive_le_const (R : ℕ)
    (F : (q : ℕ) → DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hF : ∀ q ∈ Icc 2 R, ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive → F q χ ≤ A) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive), F q χ)) ≤
        (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_weighted_primitive_le_sum_budget
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_primitive_le_sum_budget (R : ℕ)
    (F : (q : ℕ) → DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℝ) (A : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ q ∈ Icc 2 R, 0 ≤ A q)
    (hF : ∀ q ∈ Icc 2 R, ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive → F q χ ≤ A q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive), F q χ)) ≤
        ∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) * A q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_primitive_count_le
statement:
theorem weighted_primitive_count_le (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (((univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (q : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_primitive_le
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_primitive_le (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (F : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hF : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive → F χ ≤ A) :
    (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive), F χ) ≤
        (q : ℝ) * A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_low_mean_le
statement:
theorem primitive_character_low_mean_le (R V : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ _χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
        (V : ℝ) * Real.log V)) ≤ (V : ℝ) * Real.log V * (R : ℝ) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_vaughanI1_maximal_mean_le
statement:
theorem primitive_character_vaughanI1_maximal_mean_le (R U T : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
        characterVaughanI1Max U T χ)) ≤
      2 * (U : ℝ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt R * (1 + Real.log R) * Real.log T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitive_character_vaughanI2_maximal_mean_le
statement:
theorem primitive_character_vaughanI2_maximal_mean_le (R U V T : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 2 R, (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q *
      (∑ χ ∈ (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
        characterVaughanI2Max U V T χ)) ≤
      ((U * V : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (U * V : ℕ) *
        (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt R * (1 + Real.log R)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Icc_one_le_first_add_sum_Icc_two
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_one_le_first_add_sum_Icc_two (R : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : 0 ≤ f 1) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le
statement:
theorem noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le (t q : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    noncoprimeMangoldtMass t q ≤
      Real.log q + 2 * Real.sqrt t * Real.log t

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_log_add_psi_sub_theta
statement:
theorem noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_log_add_psi_sub_theta (t q : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    noncoprimeMangoldtMass t q ≤ Real.log q +
      (Chebyshev.psi (t : ℝ) - Chebyshev.theta (t : ℝ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_uniform
statement:
theorem noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_uniform (T q : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) :
    noncoprimeMangoldtMass t q ≤
      Real.log q + 2 * Real.sqrt T * Real.log T

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.noncoprimeMangoldtMass_mono
statement:
theorem noncoprimeMangoldtMass_mono (q : ℕ) :
    Monotone (fun t => noncoprimeMangoldtMass t q)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_uniform

theorem sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_uniform (T Q : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T)

    (∑ q ∈ Ioc 0 Q, noncoprimeMangoldtMass (t q) q) ≤
      Q * (Real.log Q + 2 * Real.sqrt T * Real.log T)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterExceptionBudget_le
statement:
theorem characterExceptionBudget_le (X Q : ℕ) (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hQ : Q ≤ X) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterExceptionBudget_le_log_saving
statement:
theorem characterExceptionBudget_le_log_saving (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (X Q : ℕ) (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hlog : 13 ≤ Real.log (X : ℝ))
    (hQ : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 2)) :
    characterExceptionBudget X Q ≤ (X : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_characterExceptionBudget_le
statement:
theorem eventually_characterExceptionBudget_le (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℕ,
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 2) →
      characterExceptionBudget X Q ≤ (X : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le
statement:
theorem eventually_sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℕ,
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 2) →
      ∀ t : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ q ∈ Ioc 0 Q, t q ≤ 2 * X + 2) →
      (∑ q ∈ Ioc 0 Q, noncoprimeMangoldtMass (t q) q) ≤
        (X : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_exponent_characterExceptionBudget_le
statement:
theorem exists_exponent_characterExceptionBudget_le (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℕ,
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ B →
      characterExceptionBudget X Q ≤ (X : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_characterExceptionBudget
statement:
theorem sum_noncoprimeMangoldtMass_le_characterExceptionBudget (X Q : ℕ)
    (t : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : ∀ q ∈ Ioc 0 Q, t q ≤ 2 * X + 2) :
    (∑ q ∈ Ioc 0 Q, noncoprimeMangoldtMass (t q) q) ≤
      characterExceptionBudget X Q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterMaxError_le_primitive
statement:
theorem characterMaxError_le_primitive {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (T : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    characterMaxError T χ ≤ characterMaxError T χ.primitiveCharacter + noncoprimeMangoldtMass T q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_sum_progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum
statement:
theorem eventually_sum_progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℕ,
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 2) →
      (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, progressionMaxError (2 * X + 2) q) ≤
        (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q,
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, characterMaxError (2 * X + 2) χ.primitiveCharacter) /
            Nat.totient q) + (X : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_centeredCharacterPsi_sub_primitive_le
statement:
theorem norm_centeredCharacterPsi_sub_primitive_le {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (t : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveCharacter_principal_iff
statement:
theorem primitiveCharacter_principal_iff {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum
statement:
theorem progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum (T q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    progressionMaxError T q ≤
      (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, characterMaxError T χ.primitiveCharacter) / Nat.totient q +
        noncoprimeMangoldtMass T q

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum
statement:
theorem sum_progressionMaxError_le_primitiveCharacter_sum (T Q : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q, progressionMaxError T q) ≤
      (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q,
        (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, characterMaxError T χ.primitiveCharacter) / Nat.totient q) +
        Q * (Real.log Q + 2 * Real.sqrt T * Real.log T)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.characterMaxError_primitive_changeLevel
statement:
theorem characterMaxError_primitive_changeLevel {r q : ℕ} [NeZero q]

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveCharacterMass_nonneg

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveCharacter_apply_of_primitive
TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_divisors_eq_sum_multiples
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_divisors_eq_sum_multiples (Q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_characterMaxError_primitiveCharacter_eq

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_primitiveCharacter_errors_eq_conductor_sum
statement:
theorem sum_primitiveCharacter_errors_eq_conductor_sum (T Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Icc 1 Q,
      (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, characterMaxError T χ.primitiveCharacter) /
        Nat.totient q) =
      ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 Q, primitiveCharacterMass T r *
        ∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 (Q / r), (1 : ℝ) / Nat.totient (r * k)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ico_reciprocal_product_eq
statement:

statement:

      2 * (W : ℝ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (R : ℝ)) * Real.log (T : ℝ) +
      ((W * W : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log ((W * W : ℕ) : ℝ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (R : ℝ)) +
      (W : ℝ) * Real.log (W : ℝ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 +
      2 * (dyadicNatDepth T : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.log (T : ℝ) * characterLargeSieveLogFactor R *
        ((T : ℝ) + (R : ℝ) * T *
          (1 / Real.sqrt ((W : ℝ) / 2) + 1 / Real.sqrt ((W : ℝ) / 2)) +
          (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)) ≤
      bvMeanConstant * bvMeanPolynomial T R * (Real.log (T : ℝ)) ^ 6

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvInternalCutoff_polynomial_le_four
statement:
theorem bvInternalCutoff_polynomial_le_four (T R : ℕ) (hT : 256 ≤ T) :
    ((T : ℝ) + (R : ℝ) * T *
      (1 / Real.sqrt ((bvInternalCutoff T : ℝ) / 2) +
        1 / Real.sqrt ((bvInternalCutoff T : ℝ) / 2)) +
      (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)) ≤ 4 * bvMeanPolynomial T R

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvMeanBudget_le
statement:
theorem bvMeanBudget_le (T R : ℕ) (hT : 256 ≤ T) (hRpos : 1 ≤ R)
    (hR : (R : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)) :
    (T : ℝ) * Real.log (T : ℝ) + bvTypeIBudget T R + bvTypeIIBudget T R ≤
      bvMeanConstant * bvMeanPolynomial T R * (Real.log (T : ℝ)) ^ 6

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvMeanConstant_pos
statement: theorem bvMeanConstant_pos : 0 < bvMeanConstant

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvMeanPolynomial_ge_endpoint
statement: theorem bvMeanPolynomial_ge_endpoint (T R : ℕ) : (T : ℝ) ≤ bvMeanPolynomial T R

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvMeanPolynomial_ge_modulus_sq
statement:
theorem bvMeanPolynomial_ge_modulus_sq (T R : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvMeanPolynomial_nonneg
statement: theorem bvMeanPolynomial_nonneg (T R : ℕ) : 0 ≤ bvMeanPolynomial T R

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvTypeIBudget_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvLargeConductorBudget_le_log_saving
statement:
theorem bvLargeConductorBudget_le_log_saving (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (X R₀ Q : ℕ) (hX : 256 ≤ X) (hR₀ : 1 ≤ R₀) (hRQ : R₀ ≤ Q)
    (hR : (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9) ≤ (R₀ : ℝ))
    (hQ : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9))
    (hmargin : (Real.log X) ^ (A + 8) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 16 : ℝ)) :
    totientReciprocalConstant * (1 + Real.log Q) *
        bvLargeConductorBudget (2 * X + 2) R₀ Q ≤
      (768 * totientReciprocalConstant * bvMeanConstant) * X / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_bvLargeConductorBudget_le_log_saving
statement:
theorem eventually_bvLargeConductorBudget_le_log_saving (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ R₀ Q : ℕ,
      1 ≤ R₀ → R₀ ≤ Q →
      (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9) ≤ (R₀ : ℝ) →
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9) →
      totientReciprocalConstant * (1 + Real.log Q) *
          bvLargeConductorBudget (2 * X + 2) R₀ Q ≤
        K * X / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvSmallConductorCutoff_bounds
statement:
theorem bvSmallConductorCutoff_bounds (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)

    1 ≤ bvSmallConductorCutoff A X ∧
      (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9) ≤ (bvSmallConductorCutoff A X : ℝ) ∧
      (bvSmallConductorCutoff A X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bvSmallConductorCutoff_le_log_endpoint
statement:
theorem bvSmallConductorCutoff_le_log_endpoint (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)

    (bvSmallConductorCutoff A X : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ (A + 10)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bv_admissible_modulus_bounds
statement:
theorem bv_admissible_modulus_bounds (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (X Q : ℕ) (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (X : ℝ))
    (hQ : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (Real.log X) ^ (A + 9)) :

statement:
theorem bv_admissible_modulus_le_exception_range (A : ℝ) (_hA : 0 < A)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bv_small_conductor_budget_le
statement:
theorem bv_small_conductor_budget_le (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (X Q : ℕ) (hX : 2 ≤ X)
    (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (X : ℝ)) (hQ : Q ≤ X) :
    totientReciprocalConstant * (1 + Real.log Q) *
      ((bvSmallConductorCutoff A X : ℝ) *
        (C * (2 * X + 2 : ℕ) / (Real.log (2 * X + 2 : ℕ)) ^ (2 * A + 12))) ≤
      (12 * totientReciprocalConstant * C) * X / (Real.log X) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_abs_le

theorem oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_abs_le {M : ℝ}

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_expansion
statement:
theorem oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible_expansion (U p J : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpodd : Odd p) :
    oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible U p =
      -(∑ j ∈ range J,
        oddMoebiusTotientSum (U / p ^ (j + 1)) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ (j + 1)) +
      oddMoebiusTotientSumDivisible (U / p ^ J) p / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ J

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primePowerTotientWeight_le
statement:
theorem primePowerTotientWeight_le (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpodd : Odd p)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.typeITerm_eq_odd_add_even

        ∑ n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X) with q ∣ n, vonMangoldt (n + 2)) +
      ∑ q ∈ range (U * V + 1) with Even q, vaughanCoefficient U V q *
        ∑ n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X) with q ∣ n, vonMangoldt (n + 2)
