name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_dispersion_log_pow_div_primaryCutoff
statement:
theorem tendsto_dispersion_log_pow_div_primaryCutoff (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ k / primaryCutoff X)
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_log_nat_add_one_pow_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_nat_add_one_pow_div (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ k / n) atTop (nhds 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_mul_dispersion_log_pow_of_primaryCutoff_bound
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_dispersion_log_pow_of_primaryCutoff_bound
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (m k : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop,
      |F X| ≤ C * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ m / primaryCutoff X) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => F X * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ k) atTop (nhds 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearPairs_left_le_div
statement:
theorem bilinearPairs_left_le_div {U V X : ℕ} {dr : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hdr : dr ∈ bilinearPairs U V X) : dr.1 ≤ 2 * X / (V + 1)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearPairs_right_le_div
statement:
theorem bilinearPairs_right_le_div {U V X : ℕ} {dr : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hdr : dr ∈ bilinearPairs U V X) : dr.2 ≤ 2 * X / (U + 1)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearTerm_eq_pair_sum
statement:
theorem bilinearTerm_eq_pair_sum (U V X : ℕ) :
    bilinearTerm U V X = ∑ dr ∈ bilinearPairs U V X,
      (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 * vonMangoldt (dr.1 * dr.2 + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_dispersionEntry_le_log
statement:
theorem abs_dispersionEntry_le_log (X d r : ℕ) :
    |dispersionEntry X d r| ≤ Real.log (2 * X + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBox_eq_filtered_pair_sum
statement:
theorem bilinearBox_eq_filtered_pair_sum (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    bilinearBox U V X M N =
      ∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
          (fun dr => M < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * M ∧ N < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * N),
        (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 * vonMangoldt (dr.1 * dr.2 + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBox_sq_le_dispersion
statement:
theorem bilinearBox_sq_le_dispersion (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    bilinearBox U V X M N ^ 2 ≤ dispersionMass V N *
      (dispersionDiagonal U V X M N + dispersionOffDiagonal U V X M N)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionDiagonal_le_mass
statement:
theorem dispersionDiagonal_le_mass (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    dispersionDiagonal U V X M N ≤
      M * (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ 2 * dispersionMass V N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionDiagonal_nonneg
statement:
theorem dispersionDiagonal_nonneg (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ dispersionDiagonal U V X M N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionEntry_sq_le
statement:
theorem dispersionEntry_sq_le (X d r : ℕ) :
    dispersionEntry X d r ^ 2 ≤ (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionLeft_card_le
statement: theorem dispersionLeft_card_le (U M : ℕ) : (dispersionLeft U M).card ≤ M

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionMass_le
statement:
theorem dispersionMass_le (V N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    dispersionMass V N ≤ N * Real.log (2 * N)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionMass_nonneg
statement: theorem dispersionMass_nonneg (V N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ dispersionMass V N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionRight_card_le
statement: theorem dispersionRight_card_le (V N : ℕ) : (dispersionRight V N).card ≤ N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_boxPairs_eq
statement:
theorem dispersion_boxPairs_eq (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    ((dispersionLeft U M).product (dispersionRight V N)).filter
        (fun dr => X < dr.1 * dr.2 ∧ dr.1 * dr.2 ≤ 2 * X) =
      (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
        (fun dr => M < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * M ∧ N < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * N)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_diagonal_div_sq_le
statement:
theorem dispersion_diagonal_div_sq_le (U V X M N : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hUM : U ≤ 2 * M) (hMN : M * N ≤ 2 * X) :
    dispersionMass V N * dispersionDiagonal U V X M N / (X : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      8 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 4 / U

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_diagonal_saving
statement:
theorem dispersion_diagonal_saving (U V X M N : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M * N ≤ 2 * X) :
    M * (dispersionMass V N * dispersionDiagonal U V X M N) ≤
      (2 * (X : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 4

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_mass_mul_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem dispersion_mass_mul_diagonal_le (U V X M N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    dispersionMass V N * dispersionDiagonal U V X M N ≤
      M * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.log (2 * N)) ^ 2 * (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_secondMoment_eq
statement:
theorem dispersion_secondMoment_eq (U V X M N : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ dispersionRight V N, vaughanBeta V r *
      (∑ d ∈ dispersionLeft U M, dispersionEntry X d r) ^ 2) =
        dispersionDiagonal U V X M N + dispersionOffDiagonal U V X M N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_sq_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ^ 2 =
      (∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ 2) + ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, a i * a j

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_primary_dispersion_diagonal
statement:
theorem tendsto_primary_dispersion_diagonal (M N : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hrange : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ M X ∧ 1 ≤ N X ∧ primaryCutoff X ≤ 2 * M X ∧ M X * N X ≤ 2 * X) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ =>
      (dispersionMass (primaryCutoff X) (N X) *
        dispersionDiagonal (primaryCutoff X) (primaryCutoff X) X (M X) (N X) /
          (X : ℝ) ^ 2) * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ k) atTop (nhds 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_primary_dispersion_diagonal_sqrt
statement:
theorem tendsto_primary_dispersion_diagonal_sqrt (M N : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hrange : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ M X ∧ 1 ≤ N X ∧ primaryCutoff X ≤ 2 * M X ∧ M X * N X ≤ 2 * X) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ =>
      Real.sqrt (dispersionMass (primaryCutoff X) (N X) *
        dispersionDiagonal (primaryCutoff X) (primaryCutoff X) X (M X) (N X)) /
          X * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ k) atTop (nhds 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_sq_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w a : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * a i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) * ∑ i ∈ s, w i * a i ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd_le
statement:
theorem abs_dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd_le (U V X M N G : ℕ) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    |dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd U V X M N G| ≤
      (4 * (M : ℝ) ^ 2 / G) * (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ 2 *
        dispersionMass V N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd_le_card
statement:
theorem abs_dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd_le_card (U V X M N G : ℕ) :
    |dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd U V X M N G| ≤
      (dispersionLargeGcdPairs U M G).card * (Real.log (2 * X + 2)) ^ 2 *
        dispersionMass V N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.card_largeGcd_rectangle_le
statement:
theorem card_largeGcd_rectangle_le (A B G : ℕ) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    ((((Ioc 0 A).product (Ioc 0 B)).filter
      (fun de => G < Nat.gcd de.1 de.2)).card : ℝ) ≤ (A : ℝ) * B / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionLargeGcdPairs_card_le
statement:
theorem dispersionLargeGcdPairs_card_le (U M G : ℕ) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    ((dispersionLargeGcdPairs U M G).card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (M : ℝ) ^ 2 / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionOffDiagonal_eq_small_add_large
statement:
theorem dispersionOffDiagonal_eq_small_add_large (U V X M N G : ℕ) :
    dispersionOffDiagonal U V X M N =
      dispersionOffDiagonalSmallGcd U V X M N G +
        dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd U V X M N G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersion_mass_mul_abs_largeGcd_le
statement:
theorem dispersion_mass_mul_abs_largeGcd_le (U V X M N G : ℕ)
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hG : 1 ≤ G) (hMN : M * N ≤ 2 * X) :
    dispersionMass V N * |dispersionOffDiagonalLargeGcd U V X M N G| ≤
      16 * (X : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 4 / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_inv_sq_le_inv
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_inv_sq_le_inv (k n : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (∑ i ∈ Ioc k n, ((i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ (k : ℝ)⁻¹

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearBoxLargeGcd_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearBoxLargeGcd_le (U V X M N G : ℕ)
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hG : 1 ≤ G) (hMN : M * N ≤ 2 * X) :
    |bilinearBoxLargeGcd U V X M N G| ≤
      8 * (X : ℝ) * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 2 / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearBoxLargeGcd_le_card
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearBoxLargeGcd_le_card (U V X M N G : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    |bilinearBoxLargeGcd U V X M N G| ≤
      (bilinearBoxLargeGcdPairs U V M N G).card *
        Real.log (2 * N) * Real.log (2 * X + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBoxLargeGcdPairs_card_le
statement:
theorem bilinearBoxLargeGcdPairs_card_le (U V M N G : ℕ) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    ((bilinearBoxLargeGcdPairs U V M N G).card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (M : ℝ) * N / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBoxLargeGcd_eq_filtered_pair_sum
statement:
theorem bilinearBoxLargeGcd_eq_filtered_pair_sum (U V X M N G : ℕ) :
    bilinearBoxLargeGcd U V X M N G =
      ∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
          (fun dr => (M < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * M ∧ N < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * N) ∧
            G < Nat.gcd dr.1 dr.2),
        (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 * vonMangoldt (dr.1 * dr.2 + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBoxSmallGcd_eq_filtered_pair_sum
statement:
theorem bilinearBoxSmallGcd_eq_filtered_pair_sum (U V X M N G : ℕ) :
    bilinearBoxSmallGcd U V X M N G =
      ∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
          (fun dr => (M < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * M ∧ N < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * N) ∧
            Nat.gcd dr.1 dr.2 ≤ G),
        (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 * vonMangoldt (dr.1 * dr.2 + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBox_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd
statement:
theorem bilinearBox_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd (U V X M N G : ℕ) :
    bilinearBox U V X M N =
      bilinearBoxSmallGcd U V X M N G + bilinearBoxLargeGcd U V X M N G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearBox_filtered_eq_filtered_pair_sum
statement:
theorem bilinearBox_filtered_eq_filtered_pair_sum (U V X M N : ℕ)
    (P : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (∑ dr ∈ ((dispersionLeft U M).product (dispersionRight V N)).filter P,
      vaughanBeta V dr.2 * dispersionEntry X dr.1 dr.2) =
    ∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
        (fun dr => (M < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * M ∧ N < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * N) ∧ P dr),
      (μ dr.1 : ℝ) * vaughanBeta V dr.2 * vonMangoldt (dr.1 * dr.2 + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionGcdCutoff_family_error_le
statement:
theorem dispersionGcdCutoff_family_error_le (X : ℕ) (hX : 128 ≤ X) :
    (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt (16 * (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 4 / dispersionGcdCutoff X) ≤
        4 * (2 / Real.log 2) ^ 2 / Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionGcdCutoff_le_two_log_pow
statement:
theorem dispersionGcdCutoff_le_two_log_pow (X : ℕ) :
    (dispersionGcdCutoff X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 10

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dyadicNatDepth_two_mul_le_dispersion_log
statement:
theorem dyadicNatDepth_two_mul_le_dispersion_log (X : ℕ) (hX : 128 ≤ X) :
    (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ≤
      (2 / Real.log 2) * Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.log_pow_le_dispersionGcdCutoff
statement:
theorem log_pow_le_dispersionGcdCutoff (X : ℕ) :
    (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 10 ≤ (dispersionGcdCutoff X : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.one_le_dispersionGcdCutoff
statement: theorem one_le_dispersionGcdCutoff (X : ℕ) : 1 ≤ dispersionGcdCutoff X

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.one_le_dispersion_log
statement: theorem one_le_dispersion_log (X : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sqrt_dispersionGcdCutoff_error_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_dispersionGcdCutoff_error_le (X : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (16 * (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 4 / dispersionGcdCutoff X) ≤
      4 / (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 3

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_dispersionGcdCutoff_family_error
statement:
theorem tendsto_dispersionGcdCutoff_family_error :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt (16 * (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 4 / dispersionGcdCutoff X))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_div_of_dispersionGcdCutoff_bound
statement:
theorem tendsto_div_of_dispersionGcdCutoff_bound (F : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, 0 ≤ F X)
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop,
      F X / X ≤ (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        Real.sqrt (16 * (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 4 / dispersionGcdCutoff X)) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => F X / X) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearTerm_eq_sum_dispersionBoxes
statement:
theorem bilinearTerm_eq_sum_dispersionBoxes (U V X : ℕ) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    bilinearTerm U V X =
      ∑ ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X, bilinearBox U V X (2 ^ ij.1) (2 ^ ij.2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionBoxIndices_bounds
statement:
theorem dispersionBoxIndices_bounds {U V X : ℕ} {ij : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hij : ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X) :
    1 ≤ 2 ^ ij.1 ∧ 1 ≤ 2 ^ ij.2 ∧ U ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.1 ∧ V ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.2 ∧
      2 ^ ij.1 * 2 ^ ij.2 ≤ 2 * X ∧
      ij.1 + 1 ≤ dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) ∧ ij.2 + 1 ≤ dyadicNatDepth (2 * X)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionBoxIndices_card_le
statement:
theorem dispersionBoxIndices_card_le (U V X : ℕ) :
    (dispersionBoxIndices U V X).card ≤ (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X)) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.existsUnique_dispersionBox_of_bilinearPairs
statement:
theorem existsUnique_dispersionBox_of_bilinearPairs {U V X : ℕ}
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (dr : ℕ × ℕ) (hdr : dr ∈ bilinearPairs U V X) :
    ∃! ij : ℕ × ℕ, ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X ∧
      2 ^ ij.1 < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.1 ∧
      2 ^ ij.2 < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.existsUnique_dispersion_dyadic_index
statement:
theorem existsUnique_dispersion_dyadic_index (T n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) (hnT : n ≤ T) :
    ∃! i : ℕ, i ∈ range (dyadicNatDepth T) ∧ 2 ^ i < n ∧ n ≤ 2 * 2 ^ i

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mem_dispersionBoxIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dispersionBoxIndices_iff (U V X : ℕ) (ij : ℕ × ℕ) :
    ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X ↔
      ij.1 < dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) ∧ ij.2 < dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) ∧
      U ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.1 ∧ V ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.2 ∧ 2 ^ ij.1 * 2 ^ ij.2 ≤ 2 * X

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearLargeGcd_div_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearLargeGcd_div_le (U V X G : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    |bilinearLargeGcd U V X G| / X ≤
      (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 * 8 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 2 / G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearLargeGcd_div_le_log
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearLargeGcd_div_le_log (U V X : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hX : 128 ≤ X) :
    |bilinearLargeGcd U V X (dispersionGcdCutoff X)| / X ≤
      8 * (2 / Real.log 2) ^ 2 / (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 6

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearLargeGcd_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearLargeGcd_le (U V X G : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hG : 1 ≤ G) :
    |bilinearLargeGcd U V X G| ≤
      (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (8 * (X : ℝ) * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 2 / G)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div_le_log
statement:
theorem abs_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div_le_log (X : ℕ) (hX : 128 ≤ X) :
    |primaryBilinearLargeGcd X| / X ≤
      8 * (2 / Real.log 2) ^ 2 / (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 6

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearGcdCutoff_family_error_le
statement:
theorem bilinearGcdCutoff_family_error_le (X : ℕ) (hX : 128 ≤ X) :
    (dyadicNatDepth (2 * X) : ℝ) ^ 2 * 8 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 2 /
        dispersionGcdCutoff X ≤
      8 * (2 / Real.log 2) ^ 2 / (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 6

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearLargeGcd_eq_sum_boxes
statement:
theorem bilinearLargeGcd_eq_sum_boxes (U V X G : ℕ) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    bilinearLargeGcd U V X G = ∑ ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X,
      bilinearBoxLargeGcd U V X (2 ^ ij.1) (2 ^ ij.2) G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearSmallGcd_eq_sum_boxes
statement:
theorem bilinearSmallGcd_eq_sum_boxes (U V X G : ℕ) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    bilinearSmallGcd U V X G = ∑ ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X,
      bilinearBoxSmallGcd U V X (2 ^ ij.1) (2 ^ ij.2) G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearTerm_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd
statement:
theorem bilinearTerm_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd (U V X G : ℕ) :
    bilinearTerm U V X = bilinearSmallGcd U V X G + bilinearLargeGcd U V X G

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primary_bilinear_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd
statement:
theorem primary_bilinear_eq_smallGcd_add_largeGcd (X : ℕ) :
    bilinearTerm (primaryCutoff X) (primaryCutoff X) X =
      primaryBilinearSmallGcd X + primaryBilinearLargeGcd X

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_bilinearPairs_filter_eq_sum_boxes
statement:
theorem sum_bilinearPairs_filter_eq_sum_boxes {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (U V X : ℕ) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (P : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : ℕ × ℕ → A) :
    (∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter P, f dr) =
      ∑ ij ∈ dispersionBoxIndices U V X,
        ∑ dr ∈ (bilinearPairs U V X).filter
            (fun dr => (2 ^ ij.1 < dr.1 ∧ dr.1 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.1 ∧
              2 ^ ij.2 < dr.2 ∧ dr.2 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.2) ∧ P dr), f dr

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_abs_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_abs_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => |primaryBilinearLargeGcd X| / X) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_bilinearGcd_log_error
statement:
theorem tendsto_bilinearGcd_log_error :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => 8 * (2 / Real.log 2) ^ 2 /
      (Real.log (4 * (X : ℝ) + 4)) ^ 6) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_primaryBilinearLargeGcd_div :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => primaryBilinearLargeGcd X / X) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_primary_bilinear_sub_smallGcd_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_primary_bilinear_sub_smallGcd_div :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => (bilinearTerm (primaryCutoff X) (primaryCutoff X) X -
      primaryBilinearSmallGcd X) / X) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_bilinearLargePrimeSquare_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinearLargePrimeSquare_le (U V X H : ℕ) (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hH : 1 ≤ H) :
    |bilinearLargePrimeSquare U V X H| ≤
      8 * (X : ℝ) * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 3 / H

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearLargePrimeSquareAbsMass_div_le_log
statement:
theorem bilinearLargePrimeSquareAbsMass_div_le_log (U V X : ℕ) (hX : 1 ≤ X) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearLargePrimeSquareAbsMass_nonneg

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.bilinearPrimeBetaErrorMass_nonneg

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primeVaughanBeta_apply
statement:
theorem primeVaughanBeta_apply (V r : ℕ) :
    primeVaughanBeta V r = ∑ p ∈ r.divisors, if V < p ∧ p.Prime then vonMangoldt p else 0

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primeVaughanBeta_le
statement: theorem primeVaughanBeta_le (V r : ℕ) : primeVaughanBeta V r ≤ vaughanBeta V r

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primeVaughanBeta_nonneg

    (∑ dr ∈ positiveHyperbolaPairs T, ∑ b ∈ dr.2.divisors.filter (V < ·), a b) ≤
      (T : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log T) * ∑ b ∈ Ioc V T, a b / b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_sub_primeVaughanBeta
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_sub_primeVaughanBeta (V r : ℕ) :
    vaughanBeta V r - primeVaughanBeta V r =
      ∑ b ∈ r.divisors.filter (V < ·), nonprimeMangoldt b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.coprime_small_rough
statement:
theorem coprime_small_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (haU : a ≤ U)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mangoldtHigh_mul_small_rough
statement:
theorem mangoldtHigh_mul_small_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 < a)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusLow_mul_apply_mul_rough
statement:
theorem moebiusLow_mul_apply_mul_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) (g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    (moebiusLow U * g) (a * b) =
      ∑ d ∈ a.divisors with d ≤ U, (μ d : ℝ) * g (a / d * b)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusLow_mul_beta_small_rough
statement:
theorem moebiusLow_mul_beta_small_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (haU : a ≤ U) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) :
    (moebiusLow U * vaughanBeta U) (a * b) =
      (∑ d ∈ a.divisors, (μ d : ℝ)) * Real.log b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusLow_mul_beta_squarefree_smooth_rough
statement:
theorem moebiusLow_mul_beta_squarefree_smooth_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : Squarefree a)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hsmooth : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ a → p ≤ U)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) :
    (moebiusLow U * vaughanBeta U) (a * b) =

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.small_divisor_mul_dvd_left_of_rough
statement:

statement:

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_eq_sum_primePow
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_eq_sum_primePow (U n : ℕ) :
    vaughanBeta U n =

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_mul_of_coprime (U : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) :
    vaughanBeta U (a * b) = vaughanBeta U a + vaughanBeta U b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_mul_small_rough
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_mul_small_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (haU : a ≤ U)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBeta_mul_squarefree_smooth_rough
statement:
theorem vaughanBeta_mul_squarefree_smooth_rough (U a b : ℕ) (ha : Squarefree a)
    (hsmooth : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ a → p ≤ U)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) :
    vaughanBeta U (a * b) = Real.log b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBilinear_eq_log_of_two_small_primes
statement:
theorem vaughanBilinear_eq_log_of_two_small_primes (U p q b : ℕ)
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hpU : p ≤ U) (hqU : q ≤ U) (hU : U < p * q) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hrough : ∀ r, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ b → U < r) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBilinear_eq_mangoldtHigh_sub_of_squarefree_smooth_rough
statement:
theorem vaughanBilinear_eq_mangoldtHigh_sub_of_squarefree_smooth_rough
    (U a b : ℕ) (ha : Squarefree a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsmooth : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ a → p ≤ U)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) :
    (moebiusHigh U * vaughanBeta U) (a * b) =
      mangoldtHigh U (a * b) - truncatedMoebiusSum U a * Real.log b

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vaughanBilinear_eq_mangoldt_sub_of_squarefree_smooth_rough
statement:
theorem vaughanBilinear_eq_mangoldt_sub_of_squarefree_smooth_rough
    (U a b : ℕ) (ha : Squarefree a) (hb : 0 < b) (hn : U < a * b)
    (hsmooth : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ a → p ≤ U)
    (hrough : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ b → U < p) :
    (moebiusHigh U * vaughanBeta U) (a * b) =
      vonMangoldt (a * b) - truncatedMoebiusSum U a * Real.log b

statement:

theorem vaughanBilinear_nonneg_of_two_small_primes (U p q b : ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.dispersionDiagonalSum_div_le
statement:
theorem dispersionDiagonalSum_div_le (U V X : ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hs : ∀ ij ∈ s, U ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ij.1 ∧ 2 ^ ij.1 * 2 ^ ij.2 ≤ 2 * X) :
    dispersionDiagonalSum U V X s / X ≤
      s.card * Real.sqrt (8 * (Real.log (4 * X + 4)) ^ 4 / U)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_dispersionBoxIndices_eq_active

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticSummatory_convolution_hyperbola
statement:
theorem arithmeticSummatory_convolution_hyperbola (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
    (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hyz : y * z = x) :
    arithmeticSummatory (f * g) x =
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊y⌋₊, f k * arithmeticSummatory g (x / k)) +
      (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊, g d * arithmeticSummatory f (x / d)) -
      arithmeticSummatory f y * arithmeticSummatory g z

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Ioc_convolution_hyperbola
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_convolution_hyperbola {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) (X Y Z : ℕ)
    (hlower : Y * Z ≤ X) (hupper : X < (Y + 1) * (Z + 1)) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 X, (f * g) n) =
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 Y, f k * ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 (X / k), g d) +
      (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 Z, g d * ∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 (X / d), f k) -
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 Y, f k) * (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 Z, g d)

    complexArithmeticSummatory (f * g) x =
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊y⌋₊, f k * complexArithmeticSummatory g (x / k)) +
      (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊, g d * complexArithmeticSummatory f (x / d)) -
      complexArithmeticSummatory f y * complexArithmeticSummatory g z

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.integratedWeightedPartialSum_add_sub
statement:
theorem integratedWeightedPartialSum_add_sub (a : ℕ → ℂ) (x h : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    integratedWeightedPartialSum a (x + h) - integratedWeightedPartialSum a x =
      (h : ℂ) * (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, a n) +
        ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊x⌋₊ ⌊x + h⌋₊, a n * (((x + h : ℝ) : ℂ) - (n : ℂ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference
statement:
theorem integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference (a : ℕ → ℂ) (x h : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) :
    (integratedWeightedPartialSum a (x + h) - integratedWeightedPartialSum a x) /
        (h : ℂ) =
      (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, a n) +
        ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊x⌋₊ ⌊x + h⌋₊,
          a n * ((((x + h - n) / h : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem norm_integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference_sub_sum_le
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (x h : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hh : 0 < h) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference_sub_sum_le_const
statement:
theorem norm_integratedWeightedPartialSum_forward_difference_sub_sum_le_const

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_mangoldt_character_forward_difference_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem norm_mangoldt_character_forward_difference_sub_sum_le {q : ℕ}

    (hxh : 1 ≤ x + h) :

          (x + h) -
        integratedWeightedPartialSum (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * χ n) x) /
        (h : ℂ) - (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * χ n)‖ ≤
      (h + 1) * Real.log (x + h)

statement:
theorem integrable_LSeries_mellinRamp_integrand (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.integrable_mangoldt_mellinRamp_integrand
statement:
theorem integrable_mangoldt_mellinRamp_integrand {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]

    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => (u : ℂ) ^ (-((c : ℂ) + t * I)) *
      ((-deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) ((c : ℂ) + t * I) /
        DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ ((c : ℂ) + t * I)) *
          mellinRampKernel ((c : ℂ) + t * I)))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mellinInv_LSeries_mul_mellinRampKernel
statement:
theorem mellinInv_LSeries_mul_mellinRampKernel (a : ℕ → ℂ)

    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) :
    mellinInv c (fun s => LSeries a s * mellinRampKernel s) u =

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mellinInv_LSeries_mul_mellinRampKernel_eq_weightedPartialSum

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_Icc_mangoldt_ramp_eq_mellinInv
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_mangoldt_ramp_eq_mellinInv {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 < c) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (χ n * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) *

      mellinInv c (fun s =>
        (-deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) s / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s) *
          mellinRampKernel s) (1 / x)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.verticalIntegrable_mangoldt_mellinRampKernel

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mellinVerticalSegment_sub_eq

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_mellinContourIntegrand_horizontal_le
statement:
theorem norm_mellinContourIntegrand_horizontal_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x)

    (hF : ‖F ((σ : ℂ) + t * I)‖ ≤ M) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_mellinHorizontalDifference_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_mellinVerticalSegment_le
statement:
theorem norm_mellinVerticalSegment_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (F : ℂ → ℂ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_mellinVerticalSegment_right_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_weighted_mangoldt_sum_le_contour_budget
statement:

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_weighted_mangoldt_sum_sub_vertical_le
statement:
theorem norm_weighted_mangoldt_sum_sub_vertical_le {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_vonMangoldt_sum_eq_modOne
statement:
theorem weighted_vonMangoldt_sum_eq_modOne (x : ℝ) :
    weightedPartialSum (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) x =
      weightedPartialSum (fun n : ℕ =>
        (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) n * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.weighted_vonMangoldt_sum_sub_pole_eq_contour_integral
statement:
theorem weighted_vonMangoldt_sum_sub_pole_eq_contour_integral
    (x c : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hc : 1 < c) :
    weightedPartialSum (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) x -
      mellinPoleWeight (1 / x) = (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) •
        ∫ t : ℝ, mellinContourIntegrand x negativeRegularizedZetaLogDerivative ((c : ℂ) + t * I)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_weighted_vonMangoldt_sub_pole_le_contour_budget
statement:
theorem norm_weighted_vonMangoldt_sub_pole_le_contour_budget (x a c H M : ℝ)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (ha : 0 < a) (hac : a ≤ c) (hc : 1 < c)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ negativeRegularizedZetaLogDerivative (Icc a c ×ℂ Icc (-H) H))
    (hF : ∀ s ∈ Icc a c ×ℂ Icc (-H) H, ‖negativeRegularizedZetaLogDerivative s‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖weightedPartialSum (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) x -
      mellinPoleWeight (1 / x)‖ ≤ smoothedPrincipalContourBudget x a c H M

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_weighted_vonMangoldt_sub_pole_sub_vertical_le
statement:
theorem norm_weighted_vonMangoldt_sub_pole_sub_vertical_le (x c H : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hc : 1 < c) (hH : 0 < H) :
    ‖weightedPartialSum (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) x -
        mellinPoleWeight (1 / x) - (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) •
          mellinVerticalSegment x negativeRegularizedZetaLogDerivative c H‖ ≤
      x ^ c * (mangoldtDirichletMass c + 1 / (c - 1)) / (Real.pi * H)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.contourAbsorptionConstant_pos
statement:
theorem contourAbsorptionConstant_pos (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    0 < contourAbsorptionConstant C

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_le
statement:
theorem eventually_smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_le (A k C : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hk : 0 < k) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ δ M : ℝ,
      0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 / 16 →
      k * (Real.log x) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ δ →
      0 ≤ M → M ≤ C * Real.log x →
        smoothedPrincipalContourBudget x (1 - δ) (1 + 1 / Real.log x)
          ((Real.log x) ^ (A + 2)) M ≤
            contourAbsorptionConstant C * x / (Real.log x) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedMangoldtContourBudget_le_principal
statement:
theorem smoothedMangoldtContourBudget_le_principal (x a c H M : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hc : 1 < c) (hH : 0 < H) :
    smoothedMangoldtContourBudget x a c H M ≤ smoothedPrincipalContourBudget x a c H M

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_eq
statement:
theorem smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_eq (x a c H M : ℝ) (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    smoothedPrincipalContourBudget x a c H M =
      x ^ c * (mangoldtDirichletMass c + 1 / (c - 1)) / (Real.pi * H) +
      ((1 + (a ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2) * x ^ a * M +
      (c - a) * x ^ c * M / (Real.pi * H ^ 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_le_three_errors
statement:
theorem smoothedPrincipalContourBudget_le_three_errors
    (x K k C δ M : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) (hlog : 8 ≤ Real.log x)
    (hC : 0 < C) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδu : δ ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hwidth : k * (Real.log x) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ δ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hMb : M ≤ C * Real.log x) :
    smoothedPrincipalContourBudget x (1 - δ) (1 + 1 / Real.log x) ((Real.log x) ^ K) M ≤
      42 * Real.exp 1 * x * (Real.log x) ^ (1 - K) +
      3 * C * x * Real.log x * Real.exp (-k * (Real.log x) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) +
      C * Real.exp 1 * x * (Real.log x) ^ (1 - 2 * K)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_siegelWalfisz_stripWidth_lower_bound
statement:
theorem exists_siegelWalfisz_stripWidth_lower_bound (B K d : ℝ)

      1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log x) ^ B →
        k * (Real.log x) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
          primitiveZeroFreeRectangleWidth (1 / (2 * B)) d q ((Real.log x) ^ K + 2) / 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveLogZeroFreeWidth_polylog_lower_bound

statement:
theorem siegelWalfiszStripWidthConstant_mul_rpow_le
    (B K d L : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (hK : 0 < K) (hd : 0 < d) (hL : 1 ≤ L)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_siegelWalfisz_stripBudget_bound
statement:
theorem exists_siegelWalfisz_stripBudget_bound (B K d : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hK : 0 < K) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ q : ℕ,
      1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log x) ^ B →
        primitiveStripLogDerivativeBudget q ((Real.log x) ^ K)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primitiveStripLogNumerator_polylog_le
statement:
theorem primitiveStripLogNumerator_polylog_le (B K L : ℝ)

    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqL : (q : ℝ) ≤ L ^ B) :

theorem siegelWalfiszStripBudgetConstant_bound (B K d L : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.principal_common_strip_width_and_budget
statement:
theorem principal_common_strip_width_and_budget (B K d L : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hK : 0 < K) (hd : 0 < d) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    siegelWalfiszStripWidthConstant B K d * L ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
        primitiveZeroFreeRectangleWidth (1 / (2 * B)) d 1 (L ^ K + 2) / 2 ∧
      zetaStripLogDerivativeBudget (L ^ K)
          (primitiveZeroFreeRectangleWidth (1 / (2 * B)) d 1 (L ^ K + 2) / 2) ≤

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.integrated_mangoldt_character_eq_centered
statement:
theorem integrated_mangoldt_character_eq_centered {q : ℕ}
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    integratedWeightedPartialSum (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * χ n) x =
      (x : ℂ) * (centeredWeightedCharacterSum x χ + if χ = 1 then (x : ℂ) / 2 else 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_centeredRealCharacterPsi_le_of_two_smoothed
statement:
theorem norm_centeredRealCharacterPsi_le_of_two_smoothed {q : ℕ}
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (A C x : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log x)
    (hpow : (Real.log x) ^ (A + 2) ≤ x)
    (hfirst : ‖centeredWeightedCharacterSum x χ‖ ≤ C * x / (Real.log x) ^ (2 * A + 4))
    (hsecond : ‖centeredWeightedCharacterSum (x + x / (Real.log x) ^ (A + 2)) χ‖ ≤
      C * (x + x / (Real.log x) ^ (A + 2)) /
        (Real.log (x + x / (Real.log x) ^ (A + 2))) ^ (2 * A + 4)) :
    ‖centeredRealCharacterPsi x χ‖ ≤ (5 * C + 5) * x / (Real.log x) ^ A

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.norm_centeredRealCharacterPsi_le_smoothed
statement:
theorem norm_centeredRealCharacterPsi_le_smoothed {q : ℕ}
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (x h : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hxh : 1 ≤ x + h) :
    ‖centeredRealCharacterPsi x χ‖ ≤
      ((x + h) * ‖centeredWeightedCharacterSum (x + h) χ‖ +
        x * ‖centeredWeightedCharacterSum x χ‖) / h +
      (h + 1) * Real.log (x + h) + h / 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.even_logarithmicProgression_le
statement:
theorem even_logarithmicProgression_le (U X q : ℕ) (hU : 0 < U) (hUX : U ≤ X)
    (hq : Even q) :
    |∑ n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X) with q ∣ n,
      Real.log ((n : ℝ) / U) * vonMangoldt (n + 2)| ≤
        Real.log (2 * X + 2) * evenProgressionBound X

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.logarithmicCorrection_eq_progressions
statement:
theorem logarithmicCorrection_eq_progressions (U X : ℕ) :
    logarithmicCorrection U X = ∑ q ∈ range (U + 1), (μ q : ℝ) *
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X) with q ∣ n,
        Real.log ((n : ℝ) / U) * vonMangoldt (n + 2)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.logarithmicCorrection_error_le_of_progressions
statement:
theorem logarithmicCorrection_error_le_of_progressions (U X : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hUX : U ≤ X)
    (hodd : ∀ q, Odd q →
      |(∑ n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X) with q ∣ n,
        Real.log ((n : ℝ) / U) * vonMangoldt (n + 2)) -
          logarithmicMass U X / Nat.totient q| ≤
            4 * Real.log (2 * X + 2) * progressionMaxError (2 * X + 2) q) :
    |logarithmicCorrection U X - oddMoebiusTotientSum U * logarithmicMass U X| ≤
      4 * Real.log (2 * X + 2) * ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 U, progressionMaxError (2 * X + 2) q +
        (U + 1 : ℝ) * Real.log (2 * X + 2) * evenProgressionBound X

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.logarithmicMass_le
statement:
theorem logarithmicMass_le (U X : ℕ) (hU : 0 < U) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.shiftedProgression_interval_sub_main_eq_errors
statement:

    (∑ n ∈ Ioc a b with q ∣ n, vonMangoldt (n + 2)) -
      ((b : ℝ) - a) / Nat.totient q =
        progressionError (b + 2) q 2 - progressionError (a + 2) q 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centered_bilinear_cutoff_shift_eq
statement:
theorem centered_bilinear_cutoff_shift_eq (U V W X : ℕ)
    (hV : V ≤ X) (hW : W ≤ X) :
    (bilinearTerm U V X + classicalCorrelationCenter U V X) -
        (bilinearTerm U W X + classicalCorrelationCenter U W X) =
      (typeITerm U V X - (X : ℝ) * totientTypeIMain U V) -
        (typeITerm U W X - (X : ℝ) * totientTypeIMain U W)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.correlation_sub_bilinear_add_classicalCenter_eq
statement:
theorem correlation_sub_bilinear_add_classicalCenter_eq (U V X : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hV : V ≤ X) :
    W2 X - (bilinearTerm U V X + classicalCorrelationCenter U V X) =
      (mixedCorrelation U X - (X : ℝ) * smoothedTotientSum U) +
      (logarithmicCorrection U X -
        oddMoebiusTotientSum U * logarithmicMass U X) -
      (typeITerm U V X - (X : ℝ) * totientTypeIMain U V)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.MaximalBombieriVinogradov.tendsto_log_mul_sum_error_div_of_power_level
statement:

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebius_floor_error_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebius_hyperbola
statement:
theorem moebius_hyperbola (K N : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, (μ d : ℝ) * (K * N / d : ℕ)) +
      (∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 K, moebiusSummatory (K * N / m)) - K * moebiusSummatory N = 1

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.normalizedMoebiusSum_abs_le_log_five_of_mertens
statement:
theorem normalizedMoebiusSum_abs_le_log_five_of_mertens (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, |mertensSum t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      |normalizedMoebiusSum t| ≤ (32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K / (Real.log t) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.normalizedMoebiusSum_le_of_mertens_range
statement:
theorem normalizedMoebiusSum_le_of_mertens_range (K N : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hN : 1 ≤ N)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_harmonicRemainder_le
statement:
theorem abs_harmonicRemainder_le (X d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdX : d ≤ X) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebiusHarmonicError_le
statement:
theorem abs_moebiusHarmonicError_le (X a : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc a X, |mertensSum t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :
    |moebiusHarmonicError X| ≤ 2 * a / X +
      (((32 + 2 / Real.log 2) * K) / (Real.log a) ^ 5) * (2 + 2 * Real.log X)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.harmonicRemainder_variation_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.smoothedMoebiusSum_add_harmonicRemainder
statement:
theorem smoothedMoebiusSum_add_harmonicRemainder (X : ℕ) (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    smoothedMoebiusSum X + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * normalizedMoebiusSum X +

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_reciprocalNat_Ioc

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_sum_inverse_log_five_le
statement:
theorem eventually_sum_inverse_log_five_le :

      (∑ n ∈ Icc 2 N, 1 / (Real.log n) ^ 5) ≤

statement:
theorem MaximalBombieriVinogradov.psi_real_log_six

    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_log_pow_le_self
statement:
theorem eventually_log_pow_le_self (k : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.log_le_two_log_natFloor
statement:
theorem log_le_two_log_natFloor {x : ℝ} (hx : 4 ≤ x) :
    Real.log x ≤ 2 * Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.psi_real_error_of_nat_error
statement:
theorem psi_real_error_of_nat_error (k : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |Chebyshev.psi N - (N : ℝ)| ≤ K * N / (Real.log N) ^ k) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |Chebyshev.psi x - x| ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * K + 1) * x / (Real.log x) ^ k

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.MaximalBombieriVinogradov.real_primeReciprocal_center
statement:
theorem MaximalBombieriVinogradov.real_primeReciprocal_center
    (hBV : MaximalBombieriVinogradov) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum x - Real.log x - c| ≤ C / (Real.log x) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_log_sub_log_natFloor_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_sub_log_natFloor_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 4 ≤ x) :
    |Real.log x - Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)| ≤ 2 / x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_realPrimeReciprocalSum_center_of_psi_log_six
statement:
theorem exists_realPrimeReciprocalSum_center_of_psi_log_six (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |Chebyshev.psi N - (N : ℝ)| ≤ K * N / (Real.log N) ^ 6) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum x - Real.log x - c| ≤ C / (Real.log x) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primeReciprocal_real_center_bound_of_nat
statement:
theorem primeReciprocal_real_center_bound_of_nat (c C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hcenter : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |primeReciprocalSum N - Real.log N - c| ≤ C / (Real.log N) ^ 5) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum x - Real.log x - c| ≤
        (32 * C + 2) / (Real.log x) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticSummatory_moebius_mul_centeredSelberg
statement:
theorem arithmeticSummatory_moebius_mul_centeredSelberg (c x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    arithmeticSummatory ((μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * centeredSelbergCoefficient c) x =
      moebiusLogSqSummatory x - 2 * c

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.arithmeticSummatory_vonMangoldt
statement:
theorem arithmeticSummatory_vonMangoldt (x : ℝ) :
    arithmeticSummatory vonMangoldt x = Chebyshev.psi x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centeredSelbergSummatory_eq
statement:
theorem centeredSelbergSummatory_eq (c x : ℝ) :
    centeredSelbergSummatory c x =
      arithmeticSummatory (vonMangoldt * vonMangoldt) x - primeLogSummatory x -
        (2 * c) * (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mertensReal_eq
statement: theorem mertensReal_eq (x : ℝ) : mertensReal x = mertensSum ⌊x⌋₊

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusLogSqSummatory_eq
statement:
theorem moebiusLogSqSummatory_eq (x : ℝ) :
    moebiusLogSqSummatory x =
      arithmeticSummatory (arithmeticLogWeight (arithmeticLogWeight (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ))) x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.moebiusSelberg_hyperbola
statement:
theorem moebiusSelberg_hyperbola (c x y z : ℝ)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hyz : y * z = x) :
    moebiusLogSqSummatory x - 2 * c =
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊y⌋₊, centeredSelbergCoefficient c k * mertensReal (x / k)) +
      (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊, (μ d : ℝ) * centeredSelbergSummatory c (x / d)) -
      centeredSelbergSummatory c y * mertensReal z

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.vonMangoldt_convolution_sqrt
statement:
theorem vonMangoldt_convolution_sqrt (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    arithmeticSummatory (vonMangoldt * vonMangoldt) x =
      2 * (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊Real.sqrt x⌋₊, vonMangoldt n * Chebyshev.psi (x / n)) -
        (Chebyshev.psi (Real.sqrt x)) ^ 2

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_mertensReal_mul_log_sq_le
statement:
theorem abs_mertensReal_mul_log_sq_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 4 ≤ x) (W : ℝ) (hW0 : 0 ≤ W)
    (hW : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → t ≤ x → |mertensReal t| * (Real.log t) ^ 6 / t ≤ W) :
    |mertensReal x| * (Real.log x) ^ 2 ≤ |moebiusLogSqSummatory x| +
      (Real.log 2) ^ 2 + 4 * W * (∑ t ∈ Icc 2 ⌊x⌋₊, 1 / (Real.log t) ^ 5) +
      4 * W / (Real.log x) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_mertens_mul_log_sq_le
statement:
theorem abs_mertens_mul_log_sq_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (W : ℝ) (hW0 : 0 ≤ W)
    (hW : ∀ t ∈ Icc 2 N, |mertensSum t| * (Real.log t) ^ 6 / (t : ℝ) ≤ W) :
    |mertensSum N| * (Real.log N) ^ 2 ≤ |moebiusLogSqSummatory (N : ℝ)| +
      (Real.log 2) ^ 2 + 4 * W * (∑ t ∈ Icc 2 N, 1 / (Real.log t) ^ 5)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_mertensReal_log_six_le_logSq_sum
statement:
theorem eventually_mertensReal_log_six_le_logSq_sum :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ W : ℝ, 0 ≤ W →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → t ≤ x → |mertensReal t| * (Real.log t) ^ 6 / t ≤ W) →
      |mertensReal x| * (Real.log x) ^ 6 / x ≤
        (|moebiusLogSqSummatory x| + (Real.log 2) ^ 2) * (Real.log x) ^ 4 / x +
        (128 * (1 + (14 : ℝ) ^ 5) + 4) * W / Real.log x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_mertens_log_six_le_logSq_sum
statement:
theorem eventually_mertens_log_six_le_logSq_sum :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ W : ℝ, 0 ≤ W →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 2 N, |mertensSum t| * (Real.log t) ^ 6 / (t : ℝ) ≤ W) →
      |mertensSum N| * (Real.log N) ^ 6 / (N : ℝ) ≤
        (|moebiusLogSqSummatory (N : ℝ)| + (Real.log 2) ^ 2) *
          (Real.log N) ^ 4 / (N : ℝ) +
        (4 * (1 + (14 : ℝ) ^ 5)) * W / Real.log N

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.log_sq_succ_sub_bounds
statement:
theorem log_sq_succ_sub_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ (Real.log (x + 1)) ^ 2 - (Real.log x) ^ 2 ∧
      (Real.log (x + 1)) ^ 2 - (Real.log x) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.log x / x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.mertens_mul_log_sq_eq
statement:
theorem mertens_mul_log_sq_eq (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    mertensSum N * (Real.log N) ^ 2 = moebiusLogSqSummatory (N : ℝ) +
      (Real.log 2) ^ 2 +
      ∑ t ∈ Ico 2 N, ((Real.log ((t : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 - (Real.log t) ^ 2) * mertensSum t

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_mertensReal_le
statement: theorem abs_mertensReal_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : |mertensReal x| ≤ x

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebiusLogSqSummatory_le_hyperbola_head
statement:
theorem abs_moebiusLogSqSummatory_le_hyperbola_head (c x y z K : ℝ)
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hyz : y * z = x) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ, y ≤ t → |centeredSelbergSummatory c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 5) :
    |moebiusLogSqSummatory x| ≤
      (∑ k ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊y⌋₊, |centeredSelbergCoefficient c k| * |mertensReal (x / k)|) +
      K * x / (Real.log y) ^ 5 * ((harmonic ⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) + 2 * |c|

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebiusSelberg_boundary_le
statement:
theorem abs_moebiusSelberg_boundary_le (c x y z K : ℝ)
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hyz : y * z = x) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hAy : |centeredSelbergSummatory c y| ≤ K * y / (Real.log y) ^ 5) :
    |centeredSelbergSummatory c y * mertensReal z| ≤ K * x / (Real.log y) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_moebiusSelberg_tail_le
statement:
theorem abs_moebiusSelberg_tail_le (c x y z K : ℝ)
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hyz : y * z = x) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ, y ≤ t → |centeredSelbergSummatory c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 5) :
    |∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊, (μ d : ℝ) * centeredSelbergSummatory c (x / d)| ≤
      K * x / (Real.log y) ^ 5 * (harmonic ⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.eventually_moebiusLogSqSummatory_le_power_head
statement:
theorem eventually_moebiusLogSqSummatory_le_power_head
    (c K δ : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hA : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop,
      |centeredSelbergSummatory c t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 5) :
    ∃ E : ℝ, 0 ≤ E ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |moebiusLogSqSummatory x| ≤

        E * x / (Real.log x) ^ 4

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_le_initialIntervalSup_contraction_bound

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_centeredSelbergSummatory_le_of_prime_errors
statement:
theorem abs_centeredSelbergSummatory_le_of_prime_errors
    (c x Kψ KL KP : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log x)
    (hpow : (Real.log x) ^ 5 ≤ x)
    (hKψ : 0 ≤ Kψ) (_hKL : 0 ≤ KL) (_hKP : 0 ≤ KP)
    (hψ : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sqrt x ≤ t →
      |Chebyshev.psi t - t| ≤ Kψ * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6)
    (hL : |realPrimeReciprocalSum (Real.sqrt x) - Real.log (Real.sqrt x) - c| ≤
      KL / (Real.log (Real.sqrt x)) ^ 5)
    (hP : |primeLogSummatory x - (x * Real.log x - x)| ≤ KP * x / (Real.log x) ^ 5) :
    |centeredSelbergSummatory c x| ≤
      (64 * KL + 256 * chebyshevLinearConstant * Kψ + 128 * Kψ +
        4096 * Kψ ^ 2 + KP + 2 * |c|) * x / (Real.log x) ^ 5

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_primeConvolutionError_le

      |Chebyshev.psi t - t| ≤ K * t / (Real.log t) ^ 6) :

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.centeredSelbergSummatory_sqrt_error

      2 * x * (realPrimeReciprocalSum (Real.sqrt x) - Real.log (Real.sqrt x) - c) +
      2 * primeConvolutionError x -
      2 * Real.sqrt x * (Chebyshev.psi (Real.sqrt x) - Real.sqrt x) -
      (Chebyshev.psi (Real.sqrt x) - Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 -
      (primeLogSummatory x - (x * Real.log x - x)) +
      2 * c * (x - (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ))

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.exists_centeredSelbergSummatory_bound_of_prime_errors
statement:

    (c Kψ KL KP : ℝ) (hKψ : 0 ≤ Kψ) (hKL : 0 ≤ KL) (hKP : 0 ≤ KP)

      |Chebyshev.psi x - x| ≤ Kψ * x / (Real.log x) ^ 6)
    (hL : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum x - Real.log x - c| ≤ KL / (Real.log x) ^ 5)
    (hP : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |primeLogSummatory x - (x * Real.log x - x)| ≤ KP * x / (Real.log x) ^ 5) :
    ∃ KA : ℝ, 0 ≤ KA ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,

    (∑ q ∈ (Ioc U W).filter Nat.Prime, ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 (D / q), E (q * d)) ≤

      ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 (D / q)).filter

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_largest_prime_progressionMaxError_le

        (fun d => ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ d → p < q),
        progressionMaxError Y (q * d)) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ Icc 1 D, progressionMaxError Y m

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_deriv_middlePrimeIntegrand_le

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_primeReciprocal_abel_error_le
statement:
theorem abs_primeReciprocal_abel_error_le
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y)
    (hf_int : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)) (c M : ℝ)
    (herror : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum y - Real.log y - c| ≤ M) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋₊ ⌊b⌋₊, vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) * f n) -
        (∫ y in a..b, f y / y)| ≤
      M * (|f a| + |f b| + ∫ y in a..b, |deriv f y|)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_primeReciprocal_abel_error_le_of_continuous_deriv
statement:
theorem abs_primeReciprocal_abel_error_le_of_continuous_deriv
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y)
    (hf_deriv : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)) (c M : ℝ)
    (herror : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum y - Real.log y - c| ≤ M) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋₊ ⌊b⌋₊, vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) * f n) -
        (∫ y in a..b, f y / y)| ≤
      M * (|f a| + |f b| + ∫ y in a..b, |deriv f y|)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.primeReciprocal_abel_centered_identity
statement:
theorem primeReciprocal_abel_centered_identity
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y)
    (hf_int : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋₊ ⌊b⌋₊, vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) * f n) -
        (∫ y in a..b, f y / y) =
      f b * (realPrimeReciprocalSum b - Real.log b - c) -
        f a * (realPrimeReciprocalSum a - Real.log a - c) -
          ∫ y in a..b,
            deriv f y * (realPrimeReciprocalSum y - Real.log y - c)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_logScaleTestFunction_variation_le
statement:
theorem abs_logScaleTestFunction_variation_le
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L u v K : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (huv : u ≤ v)
    (hg_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc u v, DifferentiableAt ℝ g t)
    (hg_deriv : ContinuousOn (deriv g) (Set.Icc u v))
    (hK : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc u v, |deriv g t| ≤ K) :
    (∫ y in Real.exp (u * L)..Real.exp (v * L),
      |deriv (logScaleTestFunction g L) y|) ≤ K * (v - u) / L

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_logScale_primeReciprocal_error_le
statement:
theorem abs_logScale_primeReciprocal_error_le
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L u v : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (huv : u ≤ v)
    (hg_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc u v, DifferentiableAt ℝ g t)
    (hg_deriv : ContinuousOn (deriv g) (Set.Icc u v)) (K₀ K₁ c M : ℝ)
    (hK₀ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc u v, |g t| ≤ K₀)
    (hK₁ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc u v, |deriv g t| ≤ K₁)
    (herror : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (Real.exp (u * L)) (Real.exp (v * L)),
      |realPrimeReciprocalSum y - Real.log y - c| ≤ M) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊Real.exp (u * L)⌋₊ ⌊Real.exp (v * L)⌋₊,
        vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) * (g (Real.log n / L) / L)) -
          (∫ t in u..v, g t)| ≤ M * (2 * K₀ + K₁ * (v - u)) / L

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.integral_logScaleTestFunction_div
statement:
theorem integral_logScaleTestFunction_div

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.abs_sum_mangoldt_reciprocal_sub_prime_le

theorem sum_Ioc_reciprocal_pred_mul_le (U W : ℕ) (hU : 1 ≤ U) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc U W, (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))) ≤ 1 / (U : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.sum_mangoldt_reciprocal_sub_prime_eq
statement:
theorem sum_mangoldt_reciprocal_sub_prime_eq (U W : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc U W, vonMangoldt n / n * F n) -
      (∑ p ∈ (Ioc U W).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p / p * F p) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc U W, nonprimeMangoldt n / n * F n

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_sum_mangoldt_reciprocal_sub_prime
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_mangoldt_reciprocal_sub_prime
    (U W : ℕ → ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hU : Tendsto U atTop atTop)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hF : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ n ∈ Ioc (U X) (W X), |F X n| ≤ M) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ =>
      (∑ n ∈ Ioc (U X) (W X), vonMangoldt n / n * F X n) -
        ∑ p ∈ (Ioc (U X) (W X)).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p / p * F X p)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Analytic.tendsto_sum_prime_totient_sub_reciprocal
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_prime_totient_sub_reciprocal
    (U W : ℕ → ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hU : Tendsto U atTop atTop)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hF : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ Ioc (U X) (W X), p.Prime → |F X p| ≤ M) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℕ =>
      (∑ p ∈ (Ioc (U X) (W X)).filter Nat.Prime, F X p / Nat.totient p) -
        ∑ p ∈ (Ioc (U X) (W X)).filter Nat.Prime, F X p / p)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.sum_divisors_filter_ge_le

    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) (m : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.Blocks.indicator_ge
statement:
theorem Blocks.indicator_ge (k : Fin r → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ j, blockSum (B.block j) (2 * k j) n -
        ∑ j, (blockSum (B.block j) (2 * k j) n - blockSum (B.block j) (2 * k j + 1) n) *
          ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, blockSum (B.block i) (2 * k i) n ≤
      if Nat.Coprime P n then 1 else 0

theorem prod_ge_prod_sub_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (e u l : ι → ℝ)
    (he0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) (heu : ∀ i ∈ s, e i ≤ u i) (hle : ∀ i ∈ s, l i ≤ e i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, u i - ∑ j ∈ s, (u j - l j) * ∏ i ∈ s.erase j, u i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, e i

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime

theorem prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → ℕ)

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.siftedSum_ge_brunHooley
statement:
theorem siftedSum_ge_brunHooley (s : BoundingSieve) (B : Blocks s.prodPrimes r) (k : Fin r → ℕ) :
    ∑ D ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j => (B.block j).divisors),
        (∏ j, truncMoebius (2 * k j) (D j)) * s.multSum (∏ j, D j) -
      ∑ j, ∑ D ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j => (B.block j).divisors),
        (∏ i, defect k j i (D i)) * s.multSum (∏ i, D i) ≤ s.siftedSum

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.sum_prod_mul_nu
statement:
theorem sum_prod_mul_nu (s : BoundingSieve) (B : Blocks s.prodPrimes r) (f : Fin r → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ D ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j => (B.block j).divisors),
        (∏ j, f j (D j)) * s.nu (∏ j, D j) =
      ∏ j, ∑ d ∈ (B.block j).divisors, f j d * s.nu d

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.sum_weights_prod_blockSumF

    (f : Fin r → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ s.support, s.weights n * ∏ j, blockSumF (B.block j) (f j) n =
      ∑ D ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j => (B.block j).divisors),
        (∏ j, f j (D j)) * s.multSum (∏ j, D j)

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.abs_defect_le_indicator

theorem abs_defect_le_indicator {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ) (j i : Fin r) (d : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.abs_sum_prod_mul_rem_le
statement:
theorem abs_sum_prod_mul_rem_le {r : ℕ} (s : BoundingSieve) (B : Blocks s.prodPrimes r)
    (f : Fin r → ℕ → ℝ) (m : Fin r → ℕ) (hf : ∀ i d, |f i d| ≤ if ω d ≤ m i then 1 else 0)
    (ρ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hρ : ρ.IsMultiplicative) (_hρ0 : ∀ d, 0 ≤ ρ d)
    (hrem : ∀ d, d ∣ s.prodPrimes → |s.rem d| ≤ ρ d) :
    |∑ D ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j => (B.block j).divisors),
        (∏ j, f j (D j)) * s.rem (∏ j, D j)| ≤
      ∏ j, ∑ d ∈ (B.block j).divisors with ω d ≤ m j, ρ d

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.abs_sum_truncMoebius_mul_sub_prod_le
statement:
theorem abs_sum_truncMoebius_mul_sub_prod_le (ν : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hν : ν.IsMultiplicative)
    (hν0 : ∀ d, 0 ≤ ν d) {Pj : ℕ} (hPj : Squarefree Pj) (m : ℕ) :
    |∑ d ∈ Pj.divisors, truncMoebius m d * ν d - ∏ p ∈ Pj.primeFactors, (1 - ν p)| ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Pj.divisors with m + 1 ≤ ω d, ν d

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.abs_truncMoebius_le_indicator

theorem abs_truncMoebius_le_indicator (m d : ℕ) :

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.main_term_ge
statement:
theorem main_term_ge {r : ℕ} (S T V ε : Fin r → ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, 0 < V j) (hε : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ε j)
    (hS : ∀ j, |S j - V j| ≤ ε j * V j) (_hT0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ T j) (hT : ∀ j, T j ≤ ε j * V j)
    (hsum : ∑ j, ε j ≤ 1 / 8) :
    (∏ j, V j) / 2 ≤ ∏ j, S j - ∑ j, T j * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, S i

    1 - ∑ i ∈ s, ε i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ε i)

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.siftedSum_ge_of_blocks
statement:
theorem siftedSum_ge_of_blocks {r : ℕ} (s : BoundingSieve) (B : Blocks s.prodPrimes r)
    (k : Fin r → ℕ) (hX : 0 ≤ s.totalMass) (hν0 : ∀ d, 0 ≤ s.nu d)
    (ρ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hρ : ρ.IsMultiplicative) (hρ0 : ∀ d, 0 ≤ ρ d)
    (hrem : ∀ d, d ∣ s.prodPrimes → |s.rem d| ≤ ρ d)
    (ε : Fin r → ℝ) (hε : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ε j) (hsum : ∑ j, ε j ≤ 1 / 8)
    (htail : ∀ j, ∑ d ∈ (B.block j).divisors with 2 * k j + 1 ≤ ω d, s.nu d ≤
      ε j * ∏ p ∈ (B.block j).primeFactors, (1 - s.nu p)) :
    s.totalMass * (∏ j, ∏ p ∈ (B.block j).primeFactors, (1 - s.nu p)) / 2 -
      ((r : ℝ) + 1) * ∏ j, ∑ d ∈ (B.block j).divisors with ω d ≤ 2 * k j + 1, ρ d ≤
        s.siftedSum

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.sum_defect_mul_nu_bounds
statement:
theorem sum_defect_mul_nu_bounds (ν : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hν0 : ∀ d, 0 ≤ ν d) {Pj : ℕ}
    (hPj : Squarefree Pj) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ d ∈ Pj.divisors, (truncMoebius (2 * k) d - truncMoebius (2 * k + 1) d) * ν d ∧
    ∑ d ∈ Pj.divisors, (truncMoebius (2 * k) d - truncMoebius (2 * k + 1) d) * ν d ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Pj.divisors with 2 * k + 1 ≤ ω d, ν d

name: TwinPrime.Sieve.sum_prod_mul_mult

      ∏ j, ∑ d ∈ (B.block j).divisors, f j d * h d

name: TwinPrime.twinPrimeConjecture_of_bilinear_budget
statement:
theorem twinPrimeConjecture_of_bilinear_budget
    (U V : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (X₀ : ℕ)
    (hcutoff : ∀ X ≥ X₀, 0 < U X ∧ V X ≤ X)
    (hA : ∀ X ≥ X₀, |mixedCorrelation (U X) X - C * X| ≤ C * X / 8)
    (hK : ∀ X ≥ X₀, |typeICorrection (U X) (V X) X| ≤ C * X / 8)
    (hE : ∀ X ≥ X₀, Epp X ≤ C * X / 8)
    (hB : ∀ Y : ℕ, ∃ X ≥ max Y X₀,
      -(C * X) / 2 ≤ bilinearTerm (U X) (V X) X) : TwinPrimeConjecture

      |mixedCorrelation (U X) X - (2 * twinPrimeConstant) * X| ≤
        (2 * twinPrimeConstant) * X / 8)
    (hK : ∀ X ≥ X₀, |typeICorrection (U X) (V X) X| ≤
      (2 * twinPrimeConstant) * X / 8)
    (hE : ∀ X ≥ X₀, Epp X ≤ (2 * twinPrimeConstant) * X / 8)
    (hB : ∀ Y : ℕ, ∃ X ≥ max Y X₀,

    TwinPrimeConjecture

theorem parity_obstruction (x z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x < z * z)

    ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors,
          |μ d| * |∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (liouville n : ℝ)|

      ≤ 2 * #{n ∈ range (x + 1) | Nat.Coprime (primorial z) (n * (n + 2)) ∧ Even (Ω n)}
        + ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors,
            |μ d| * |∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (liouville n : ℝ)|

name: TwinPrime.parity_obstruction_level

theorem parity_obstruction_level (x z D : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x < z * z)

    (hsupp : ∀ d, D < d → μ d = 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors with d ≤ D,

name: TwinPrime.parity_obstruction_upper
statement:
theorem parity_obstruction_upper (x z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x + 2 < z * z)
    (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (hμ : BoundingSieve.IsUpperMoebius μ) :
    2 * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | z < n ∧ n.Prime ∧ (n + 2).Prime} : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
        + ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors,
            |μ d| * |∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (liouville n : ℝ)|

name: TwinPrime.prime_of_coprime_primorial
statement:
theorem prime_of_coprime_primorial {x z n : ℕ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x < z * z) (hn : n ≤ x)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (primorial z) (n * (n + 2))) : n.Prime

name: TwinPrime.prime_of_forall_prime_factor_gt
statement:
theorem prime_of_forall_prime_factor_gt {n z : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hnz : n < z * z)
    (h : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ n → z < p) : n.Prime

name: TwinPrime.sieve_expr_le_twin_count
statement:
theorem sieve_expr_le_twin_count (x z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x + 2 < z * z)
    (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (hμ : IsLowerMoebius μ) :
    ∑ d ∈ (primorial z).divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
      ≤ #{n ∈ range (x + 1) | z < n ∧ n.Prime ∧ (n + 2).Prime}

name: TwinPrime.sieve_expr_split
statement:
theorem sieve_expr_split (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (P x : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (1 + (liouville n : ℝ))
      = ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
        + ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (liouville n : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.sieve_expr_split_sub
statement:
theorem sieve_expr_split_sub (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (P x : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (1 - (liouville n : ℝ))
      = ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * (#{n ∈ range (x + 1) | d ∣ n * (n + 2)} : ℝ)
        - ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with d ∣ n * (n + 2), (liouville n : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.sum_filter_coprime_eq
statement:
theorem sum_filter_coprime_eq (P : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ s with Nat.Coprime P (f n), a n
      = ∑ n ∈ s, a n * (if Nat.gcd P (f n) = 1 then 1 else 0)

name: TwinPrime.sum_filter_one_add_liouville
statement:
theorem sum_filter_one_add_liouville (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ s, (1 + (liouville n : ℝ)) = (#s : ℝ) + ∑ n ∈ s, (liouville n : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.sum_filter_one_sub_liouville
statement:
theorem sum_filter_one_sub_liouville (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ s, (1 - (liouville n : ℝ)) = (#s : ℝ) - ∑ n ∈ s, (liouville n : ℝ)

name: TwinPrime.sum_lowerMoebius_le
statement:
theorem sum_lowerMoebius_le (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (hμ : IsLowerMoebius μ) (P : ℕ) (hP : 0 < P)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n ∈ s, 0 ≤ a n) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ s with d ∣ f n, a n
      ≤ ∑ n ∈ s with Nat.Coprime P (f n), a n

name: TwinPrime.sum_mul_sum_filter_dvd
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sum_filter_dvd (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (hP : 0 < P) (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, μ d * ∑ n ∈ s with d ∣ f n, a n
      = ∑ n ∈ s, a n * ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd P (f n)).divisors, μ d

name: TwinPrime.sum_one_add_liouville_sifted
statement:
theorem sum_one_add_liouville_sifted (x z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x < z * z) :
    ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with Nat.Coprime (primorial z) (n * (n + 2)),
      (1 + (liouville n : ℝ)) = 0

name: TwinPrime.sum_one_sub_liouville_sifted
statement:
theorem sum_one_sub_liouville_sifted (x z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hxz : x < z * z) :
    ∑ n ∈ range (x + 1) with Nat.Coprime (primorial z) (n * (n + 2)),
      (1 - (liouville n : ℝ))
      = 2 * #{n ∈ range (x + 1) | Nat.Coprime (primorial z) (n * (n + 2))}

name: TwinPrime.cardFactors_eq_one_or_two_of_rough
statement:
theorem cardFactors_eq_one_or_two_of_rough {n z : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hnz : n < z ^ 3) (hrough : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ n → z < p) :
    Ω n = 1 ∨ Ω n = 2

name: TwinPrime.one_sub_liouville_eq_prime_selector_of_rough
statement:
theorem one_sub_liouville_eq_prime_selector_of_rough {n z : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hnz : n < z ^ 3) (hrough : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ n → z < p) :
    1 - (liouville n : ℝ) = if n.Prime then 2 else 0

name: TwinPrime.prime_or_semiprime_of_rough
statement:
theorem prime_or_semiprime_of_rough {n z : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hnz : n < z ^ 3) (hrough : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ n → z < p) :
    n.Prime ∨ ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ n = p * q

name: TwinPrime.rough_liouville_selector
statement:
theorem rough_liouville_selector {X z n : ℕ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hzX : z < X)
    (hcube : 2 * X + 2 < z ^ 3) (hn : n ∈ roughDyadicSet X z) :
    (1 - (liouville n : ℝ)) * (1 - (liouville (n + 2) : ℝ)) =
      if n ∈ twinPrimes then 4 else 0

name: TwinPrime.rough_liouville_weighted_identity
statement:
theorem rough_liouville_weighted_identity (X z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hzX : z < X)
    (hcube : 2 * X + 2 < z ^ 3) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    4 * ∑ n ∈ (Ioc X (2 * X)).filter (· ∈ twinPrimes), a n =
      ∑ n ∈ roughDyadicSet X z,
        a n * ((1 - (liouville n : ℝ)) * (1 - (liouville (n + 2) : ℝ)))

name: TwinPrime.rough_parity_identity
statement:
theorem rough_parity_identity (X z : ℕ) (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hzX : z < X)
    (hcube : 2 * X + 2 < z ^ 3) :
    4 * (N2 X : ℝ) = roughParityCombination X z

name: TwinPrime.twinPrimeConjecture_of_cofinal_roughParity_pos
statement:
theorem twinPrimeConjecture_of_cofinal_roughParity_pos
    (h : ∀ Y : ℕ, ∃ X ≥ Y, ∃ z : ℕ, 3 ≤ z ∧ z < X ∧
      2 * X + 2 < z ^ 3 ∧ 0 < roughParityCombination X z) :
    TwinPrimeConjecture

name: TwinPrime.twinPrimeConjecture_of_rough_distribution_and_parity
statement:
theorem twinPrimeConjecture_of_rough_distribution_and_parity
    (z : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (X₀ : ℕ)
    (hrange : ∀ X ≥ X₀, 3 ≤ z X ∧ z X < X ∧ 2 * X + 2 < (z X) ^ 3)
    (hM : ∀ X ≥ X₀, 0 < M X)
    (hdistribution : ∀ X ≥ X₀, M X ≤ (roughDyadicCount X (z X) : ℝ))
    (hparity : ∀ Y : ℕ, ∃ X ≥ max Y X₀,
      roughLiouvilleLeft X (z X) + roughLiouvilleRight X (z X) -
        roughLiouvilleProduct X (z X) ≤ (1 - δ) * M X) :
    TwinPrimeConjecture

name: TwinPrime.twin_mem_roughDyadicSet
statement:
theorem twin_mem_roughDyadicSet {X z n : ℕ} (hzX : z < X)
    (hn : n ∈ Ioc X (2 * X)) (htwin : n ∈ twinPrimes) :
    n ∈ roughDyadicSet X z

name: TwinPrime.one_le_log_three
statement: theorem one_le_log_three : 1 ≤ Real.log 3

name: TwinPrime.sqrt_mul_log_sq_le
statement: theorem sqrt_mul_log_sq_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ^ 24 ≤ x) : Real.sqrt x * (Real.log x) ^ 2 ≤ x / 2

name: TwinPrime.three_le_zL
statement: theorem three_le_zL {x : ℕ} (hx : 3 ^ 6 ≤ x) : 3 ≤ zL x

name: TwinPrime.three_pow_zL_le
statement: theorem three_pow_zL_le {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : (3 : ℝ) ^ (zL x + 1) ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt x

name: TwinPrime.zL_le
statement: theorem zL_le {x : ℕ} : (zL x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log x / (2 * Real.log 3)
